Diese Position berichtet an:

Procurement & Logistics Manager

Join ABB and help us drive the future of technology. Wir suchen einen proaktiven und strategischen Beschaffungsspezialisten, der unserem Team beitritt. In dieser Rolle sind Sie entscheidend für die Optimierung unserer Lieferkette, die Verwaltung der Lieferantenbeziehungen und die Sicherstellung, dass unsere Produkte wettbewerbsfähig und nachhaltig bleiben.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für

  • Entwirft und implementiert Pläne, e führt Einkaufs- und Logistikstrategien aus, um das Geschäft durch die Optimierung von Kosten, Qualität, Lieferung und Zuverlässigkeit von Lieferanten und gelieferten Produkten zu unterstützen.

  • Unterstützt den Beschaffungsmanager bei der Umsetzung effektiver lokaler Beschaffungsstrategien im Einklang mit der Strategie der Division, um aktuelle und zukünftige Geschäftsanforderungen zu erfüllen.

  • Wendet Beschaffungsstandards, Werkzeuge und Prozesse in ihrem eigenen Verantwortungsbereich an, um Qualität, Lieferung, Kosten und Nachhaltigkeit zu sichern.

  • Verfolgt die Lieferantenleistung Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Qualitätsprobleme, Beschaffungsprozesse und -aktivitäten und erstellt und aktualisiert Berichte nach Bedarf nach den ABB-Standards.


• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • 3 - 5 Jahre Erfahrung in elektromechanischen/elektronischen Komponenten, wie Sensoren, Schalter, Relais, Steckverbinder, Sicherungen, Kabel-Harnesses, passive/aktive Komponenten und/oder PCBAs Management.

  • Strong negotiation skills.

  • A degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in management supplier performance and KPIs.

  • < Mehr über uns

    ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Produktionsanlagen, kritische Infrastrukturen und Geschäftsgebäude. Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitsgeräte wie Schalter und Relais. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Der ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager der Division bietet eine skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Plattform, mit der Unternehmen Energie sparen und CO2-Emissionen reduzieren können.

    Rekrutierungsleiter für diese Position: Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner bei ABB Schweiz.

    Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

    Ready to make a impact?

    Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire des achats et de la logistique

Rejoignez ABB et aidez-nous à diriger l'avenir de la technologie. Nous cherchons un spécialiste des achats proactif et stratégique pour rejoindre notre équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous serez crucial pour optimiser notre chaîne d'approvisionnement, gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs et veiller à ce que nos produits demeurent concurrentiels et durables.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-Hybrid

Vous serez principalement responsable de

  • Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des plans, exécute des stratégies d'achat et de logistique pour appuyer l'entreprise en optimisant les coûts, la qualité, la livraison et la fiabilité des fournisseurs et des produits fournis.

  • Appuye le gestionnaire des achats dans la mise en oeuvre de stratégies d'approvisionnement locales efficaces conformément à la stratégie de la division pour répondre aux exigences opérationnelles actuelles et futures.

  • Applique et met en oeuvre des normes, des outils et des processus d'approvisionnement dans leur propre secteur de responsabilité afin d'assurer la qualité, la prestation, le coût et la durabilité.

  • Suivre le rendement des fournisseurs Indicateurs clés de rendement (ICP), questions de qualité, processus et activités d'approvisionnement, et créer et mettre à jour des rapports, au besoin, conformément aux normes ABB.


•

< Plus sur nous

ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les centres de données, les usines industrielles et manufacturières, les infrastructures essentielles et les bâtiments commerciaux. Les équipes techniques de la Division travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de l'industrie, fournissant des solutions avancées qui soutiennent la croissance rapide, la transition énergétique et les objectifs de durabilité. Le portefeuille de la Division comprend des disjoncteurs industriels, des systèmes à basse tension, des applications de démarrage de moteurs et des dispositifs de sécurité comme les commutateurs et les relais. Son unité de protection de l'énergie prend en charge les plus grandes entreprises de centres de données du monde avec des solutions UPS à haut rendement énergétique. La division ABB CapabilityTM Energy Manager fournit une plateforme évolutive et facile à utiliser qui aide les organisations à économiser de l'énergie et à réduire les émissions de CO2.

Responsable du recrutement pour ce poste : Pedro Labian Sanchez, associé d'acquisition de talents chez ABB Suisse.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer (Medium-Voltage Systems) (m/w/d) 80 - 100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Engineering Manager

__

Commissioning Engineer (Medium-Voltage Systems)

This position reports to: Engineering Manager

Your Role and • Responsibilities

To strengthen our Engineering team in the field of protection technology, we are looking for an experienced Commissioning Engineer for Medium Voltage Switchgear.

You will apply your technical skills across various phases of customer projects, ensuring that all commissioning activities are completed efficiently and cost-effectively in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, as well as cybersecurity guidelines and standards. You will also demonstrate your expertise by supporting the continuous improvement of project processes, product, and system design.

Work Model: hybrid

You will be primarily responsible for:

  • Independent commissioning of medium voltage switchgear as well as protection and control systems, taking into account customer requirements, technical specifications, and applicable quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

  • Parameterization and configuration of ABB protection relays and RTUs, as well as execution and documentation of functional, protection, and secondary tests.

  • Analysis and diagnosis of technical faults in protection and automation systems, support in second-level support, and participation in on-call duty (piquet service).

  • Supporting sales and project management in technical reviews and in technical discussions with customers and partners; conducting customer training on the operation of protection relays.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Technical foundation education and a completed degree in Engineering, Automation Technology, or a related technical field.

  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in commissioning or engineering of systems in the field of energy and protection technology.

  • Solid knowledge of software programming using FUPLA as well as communication protocols such as IEC 61850, Modbus, and IEC 60870-5-104.

  • Strong focus on safe working practices and commitment to compliance with all relevant safety guidelines.

  • Independent, structured, and responsible working style, high self-motivation, openness to new topics, and willingness to continuously acquire new technologies.

  • Very good German and good English language skills. French is an advantage.

  • High willingness to travel (approx. 60–70%) within Switzerland, as well as willingness to take on on-call duties (approx. 7 times per year).

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Attractive and performance-based compensation including bonus, 13th monthly salary, and employee share participation program (ESAP).

  • Minimum 27 vacation days.

  • Comprehensive training and development opportunities.

  • Modern working environment and international collaboration.

  • Company social benefits and various employee discounts.

Inbetriebsetzungs-Ingenieur (Mittelspannungsanlagen)

Diese Position berichtet an: Engineering Manager

Ihre Rolle und Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten
Zur Verstärkung unseres Engineering-Teams im Bereich Schutztechnik suchen wir einen erfahrenen Inbetriebsetzungs-Ingenieur für Mittelspannungsanlagen.

Sie setzen Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten in verschiedenen Phasen von Kundenprojekten ein und stellen sicher, dass alle Inbetriebsetzungen effizient und kostengünstig gemäss Vertragsspezifikationen, Qualitätsstandards, Sicherheitsanforderungen sowie Cybersicherheitsrichtlinien und -standards abgeschlossen werden. Sie zeigen ausserdem Ihre Expertise, indem Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserung des Projektprozess-, Produkt- und Systemdesigns unterstützen.


Arbeitsmodell: hybrid

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Eigenverantwortliche Inbetriebsetzung von Mittelspannungs-Schaltanlagen sowie Schutz- und Leittechniksystemen unter Berücksichtigung von Kundenanforderungen, technischen Spezifikationen sowie geltenden Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Normvorgaben.

  • Parametrierung und Konfiguration von ABB-Schutzrelais und RTUs sowie Durchführung und Dokumentation von Funktions-, Schutz- und Sekundärprüfungen.

  • Analyse und Diagnose technischer Störungen an Schutz- und Automatisierungssystemen, Unterstützung im Second-Level-Support sowie Teilnahme am Pikettdienst.

  • Unterstützung von Verkauf und Projektleitung bei technischen Reviews sowie bei fachlichen Diskussionen mit Kunden und Partnern; Durchführung von Kundenschulungen zur Bedienung der Schutzrelais


Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Technische Grundausbildung sowie ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Ingenieurwesen, Automatisierungstechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Inbetriebsetzung von Anlagen im Bereich Energie- und Schutztechnik

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Softwareprogrammierung mittels FUPLA sowie in Kommunikationsprotokollen wie IEC 61850, Modbus und IEC 60870-5-104

  • Starker Fokus auf sicheres Arbeiten und Engagement für die Einhaltung aller relevanten Sicherheitsrichtlinien

  • Selbstständiges, strukturiertes und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten, hohe Eigenmotivation, Aufgeschlossenheit gegenüber neuen Themen sowie die Bereitschaft, sich kontinuierlich neue Technologien anzueignen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Französisch von Vorteil

  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft (ca. 60-70 %) innerhalb der Schweiz sowie Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Pikettdiensten (ca. 7-mal jährlich)


Leistungen
• Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern ausserdem folgende Vorteile an:

  • Attraktive und leistungsorientierte Vergütung inkl. Bonus, 13. Monatslohn und Aktienbeteiligungsprogramm (ESAP)

  • Mindestens 27 Urlaubstage

  • Umfassende Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld und internationale Zusammenarbeit

  • Betriebliche Sozialleistungen und diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte

More About Us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations.

We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

The recruitment process is supported by Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor - Prototype Construction

__

Your Role

In this role, you support the Prototype Construction area in ensuring efficient material supply and coordinating prototype construction processes. You work closely with internal interfaces and make a significant contribution to timely and high-quality prototype manufacturing.


Work Model: On-site

This position supports the Electrification Smart Buildings division, Business Line Energy Distribution, in Schaffhausen.


Your Main • Responsibilities

  • Planning, coordination and implementation of prototype and sample construction orders in close collaboration with Development, Engineering, Production, Quality and SCM
  • Management of production, work and process documentation as well as bill of materials and manufacturing documents (creation, maintenance and updating)
  • Material flow management: ensuring timely material availability for prototypes and pre-series, monitoring material bottlenecks and initiating appropriate measures
  • Process optimization: planning and organization of workflows as well as continuous improvement according to Lean principles

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed technical vocational training
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in an industrial production or engineering environment, ideally in prototype, sample construction or manufacturing
  • Technical understanding and experience reading technical drawings and bill of materials
  • Good knowledge of ERP systems (SAP an advantage) and MS Office applications
  • Enjoyment of collaborating with different departments and coordinating various tasks
  • Strong communication skills with high self-initiative and hands-on mentality
  • Fluent German; English skills are an advantage

What We Offer

We want you to bring your full potential – your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You will receive the tools and freedom to further develop your skills, shape your own path and take on challenges that truly matter. Your work has visible and tangible impact every day.


Benefits

• We offer a range of attractive benefits to support your well-being and work-life balance:

  • REKA vouchers for leisure and travel
  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year
  • Various health and wellness benefits
  • Gym membership contribution

About Us

ABB Smart Buildings enables the optimization of energy efficiency, security and comfort for every building type through new installations or retrofit solutions. The division offers integrated digital technologies for controlling HVAC, lighting, blinds and security as well as energy distribution solutions, including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial connectors and sockets and conventional cabling accessories, suitable for single-family homes, multi-family residences, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.

The division's highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve the worldwide increasing demand from real estate developers, owners and investors for intelligent building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to achieve significant sustainable and financial benefits, meet social and environmental requirements while being able to meet even the most complex customer carbon reduction strategies.


This recruitment process is supported by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in modern cross-platform mobile development, specifically leveraging Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Compose Multiplatform, backed by experience in DevOps, Azure, and Cyber Security.

The successful candidate will play a crucial role in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining cutting-edge applications within the Digital Agile Unit. This role focuses on digital products, covering IoT, cloud platforms, SW Tools, APPs, and Data Management In addition, you will apply AI-assisted and agentic programming practices in daily development activities.

In this role, it is also essential to follow cybersecurity standards, apply appropriate security measures throughout the development process, and comply with ABB’s secure development lifecycle. These practices help ensure that the software released is highly reliable, robust, and secure.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid (#LI-Hybrid)

Key • Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Development: Designing cross-platform mobile applications using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Compose Multiplatform, optimizing code sharing across Android and iOS without compromising native performance or UI/UX fidelity.
  • AI-Driven Productivity & Agentic Engineering: Championing the adoption of AI pair-programming tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and agentic workflows to streamline code generation, automated unit testing, refactoring, and technical documentation while enforcing human-in-the-loop validation and security.
  • System & Device Integration: Optimizing designs by identifying the best technical solutions, including services, architectural choices, and technical details. Emphasis is placed on seamless integration between software applications and smart devices/hardware via IoT protocols (e.g., Bluetooth LE, MQTT).
  • Agile Collaboration: Applying Scrum methodology (Epics, Features, User Stories, Bugs). Actively participating in Scrum ceremonies and collaborating closely with cross-functional development, UX/UI, and test teams within the Agile unit.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Implementing and maintaining modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) tailored for multiplatform targets to ensure efficient release management, automated UI/unit testing, and reliable software delivery.
  • Software Excellence: Ensuring code quality by applying modern architectural patterns (MVI/MVVM, Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection via Koin/Dagger), performing rigorous code reviews, conducting static code analysis, and leveraging static analysis tools (e.g., Detekt, SonarQube).
  • Security & Compliance: Implementing cybersecurity measures by following the Security Development Lifecycle (SDL), ensuring robust data encryption at rest and in transit, secure storage (Keychain/EncryptedSharedPreferences), and meeting defined security requirements throughout development.
  • Local & Cloud Data Management: Designing and optimizing local persistence solutions (e.g., Room, SQLDelight) and managing seamless integration with cloud backends and RESTful/GraphQL APIs.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Degree: Bachelor or master’s degree in electronic/computer science engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Core Mobile Expertise: Solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), and Compose Multiplatform (Declarative UI) for iOS/Android target execution.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent AI-assisted coding tools / LLM agents to accelerate software delivery, prompt-driven prototyping, and code reviews safely and securely.
  • Asynchronous & Reactive Programming: Strong knowledge of Kotlin Coroutines and Flow for concurrent state and stream management.
  • Architecture & Libraries: Deep understanding of modern Android/KMP architecture principles, lifecycle management, state handling, and dependency injection frameworks (e.g., Koin).
  • DevOps & Cloud Integration: Familiarity with cloud environments (particularly Azure) and experience setting up CI/CD pipelines for mobile delivery.
  • API & Connectivity: Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs, modern networking libraries (e.g., Ktor, Retrofit), and IoT device communication protocols (e.g., BLE, Wi-Fi provisioning).
  • Cybersecurity: Strong understanding of mobile security best practices, static analysis tools, and secure data handling under SDL protocols.
  • Methodology: Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
  • Soft Skills: Innovative approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and collaborative mindset.
  • Languages: Fluent in English and Italian.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows for code automation, spec-to-code generation, and automated PR review bots.
  • Familiarity with Swift/Swift UI for platform-specific iOS bridge integrations.
  • Experience with local database frameworks suitable for KMP (e.g., Room KMP, SQL Delight).
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and monitoring tools.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Questo ruolo si concentra sulle attività di digital products In questo ruolo, è anche essenziale seguire gli standard di sicurezza informatica, applicare adeguate misure di sicurezza durante il processo di sviluppo, e rispettare il ciclo di vita sicuro di sviluppo di ABB. Queste pratiche aiutano a garantire che il software rilasciato sia altamente affidabile, robusto e sicuro. Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: ibrido (#LI-Hybrid) chiave • Responsabilità: Progettare applicazioni mobili cross-platform utilizzando Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) e Compose Multiplatform , ottimizzare la condivisione del codice su Android e iOS senza compromettere le prestazioni native o la fedeltà UI/UX. Campione dell'adozione di strumenti di programmazione di coppia AI (ad esempio, GitHub Copilot) Ottimizzazione dei progetti identificando le migliori soluzioni tecniche, inclusi servizi, scelte architettoniche e dettagli tecnici. L'enfasi è posta sull'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra applicazioni software e dispositivi intelligenti/hardware tramite protocolli IoT (ad esempio, Bluetooth LE, MQTT). Applicare la metodologia Scrum (Epici, Caratteristiche, Storie utente, Bugs). Partecipano attivamente alle cerimonie Scrum e collaborano strettamente con lo sviluppo interfunzionale, UX/UI e i team di test all'interno dell'unità Agile. Attuazione e mantenimento di moderni gasdotti CI/CD (ad esempio, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) su misura per obiettivi multipiattaforma per garantire efficient release management, UI/unit testing automatizzato e distribuzione software affidabile. Garantire la qualità del codice applicando modelli architettonici moderni (MVI/MVM, Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection via Koin/Dagger), eseguendo rigorose revisioni del codice, conducendo analisi del codice statico e sfruttando strumenti di analisi statica (ad esempio, Detekt, SonarQube). Implementare le misure di sicurezza informatica seguendo il ciclo di vita di sviluppo di sicurezza (SDL), assicurando la crittografia dei dati robusta a riposo e in transito, lo storage sicuro (Keychain/EncryptedSharedPreferences), e soddisfare i requisiti di sicurezza definiti durante lo sviluppo. Progettare e ottimizzare soluzioni di persistenza locale (ad esempio, Room, SQLDelight) e gestire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità con backend cloud e API RESTful/GraphQL. • Qualifiche per il ruolo: Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettronica/informatica, informatica o un campo tecnico correlato. Esperienza solida con Kotlin , Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) e Compose Multiplatform (UI dichiarativa) per l'esecuzione dell'obiettivo iOS/Android. Esperienza pratica con GitHub Copilot, Cursor, o equivalente AI-assistito strumenti di codifica / LLM agenti Comprensione profonda dei moderni principi di architettura Android/KMP, gestione del ciclo di vita, gestione dello stato e sistemi di iniezione di dipendenza (ad esempio, Koin ). Familiarità con gli ambienti cloud (in particolare Azure ) e l'esperienza di creazione di pipeline CI/CD per la consegna mobile. Esperienza pratica con le API RESTful, le librerie di rete moderne (ad esempio, Ktor , Retrofit), e i protocolli di comunicazione dei dispositivi IoT (ad esempio, BLE, Wi-Fi provisioning). Una forte comprensione delle migliori pratiche di sicurezza mobile, degli strumenti di analisi statiche e della gestione sicura dei dati sotto i protocolli SDL. Un approccio innovativo alla risoluzione dei problemi, alle forti capacità di comunicazione e alla mentalità collaborativa. Familiarità con flussi di lavoro agentici per l'automazione del codice, la generazione spec-to-code e robot di revisione PR automatizzati. Esperienza con i framework di database locali adatti a KMP (ad esempio, Room KMP, SQL Delight). I team tecnici della Divisione lavorano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore, offrendo soluzioni avanzate che supportano obiettivi di crescita rapida, transizione energetica e sostenibilità. Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS ad alta efficienza energetica. ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager offre una piattaforma scalabile e facile da usare che consente alle organizzazioni di risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2. Questa opportunità è aperta ai candidati in più paesi, con la posizione di lavoro finale determinata in base al candidato selezionato. Poiché la compensazione può variare in base alla posizione, ci impegniamo ad essere trasparenti durante il processo di assunzione e condividere i dettagli della gamma salariale, il pacchetto di compensazione e benefici variabili con i candidati che progrediscono alla prima fase di intervista per una posizione nell'Unione europea, coperta dalla direttiva UE sulla trasparenza dei pagamenti. L'offerta finale sarà adattata in base alla vostra posizione di ruolo, esperienza, competenze e qualifiche, posizionamento del mercato interno e allineamento con gli standard interni ABB.

  • Productivité entraînée par l'IA et génie agentique: Promouvoir l'adoption d'outils de programmation par paires d'AI (p. ex., le copilote GitHub) et de workflows d'agents pour rationaliser la génération de code, les tests automatisés des unités, la refacturation et la documentation technique tout en assurant la validation et la sécurité de l'humain dans la boucle.
  • Intégration du système et de l'appareil: Optimiser les conceptions en identifiant les meilleures solutions techniques, y compris les services, les choix architecturaux et les détails techniques. L'accent est mis sur l'intégration transparente entre les applications logicielles et les appareils/matériels intelligents via les protocoles IoT (p. ex. Bluetooth LE, MQTT).
  • Collaboration agile : Appliquer la méthodologie Scrum (Epics, Caractéristiques, User Stories, Bugs). Participation active aux cérémonies de Scrum et collaboration étroite avec les équipes de développement interfonctionnel, UX/UI et de test au sein de l'unité Agile.

  • Excellence en logiciel: Assurer la qualité du code en appliquant des modèles architecturaux modernes (MVI/MVVM, architecture propre, injection de dépendance via Koin/Dagger), en effectuant des examens rigoureux du code, en effectuant des analyses de code statique et en tirant parti des outils d'analyse statique (p. ex., Detekt, SonarQube).

  • DevOps & Cloud Integration: Connaissance des environnements nuageux (en particulier Azure) et expérience de la mise en place de pipelines CI/CD pour la livraison mobile.
  • API & Connectivité: Expérience pratique avec les API REST, les bibliothèques de réseautage modernes (p. ex., Ktor, Retrofit) et les protocoles de communication des appareils IoT (p. ex., BLE, fourniture Wi-Fi).
  • Cybersecurity: Une bonne compréhension des pratiques exemplaires en matière de sécurité mobile, des outils d'analyse statique et du traitement sécurisé des données en vertu des protocoles SDL.
  • Méthodologie: Expérience pratique des méthodes de développement Agile/Scrum.

  • Familiarité avec l'interface utilisateur Swift/Swift pour les intégrations de ponts iOS spécifiques à la plate-forme.

jobs.title: R&D Finance Analyst
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global R&D Controller

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide financial expertise to your assigned organization. Each day, you will compile and analyze various relevant metrics, identify trends and problems, and communicate information to relevant groups. You will also showcase your expertise by recommending actions to improve financial performance of a specific business.

This role is contributing to the MOPH in Global R&D function. Main stakeholders are MOHP, MODP and MO Research Center.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Support month-end closing activities, ensuring accuracy and integrity of financial data through reconciliations, validation, and exception analysis. Ensure compliance of processes and internal controls with company policies and regulatory requirements.

  • Support financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and business planning processes. Prepare management reports and presentations, summarizing key insights and recommendations.

  • Act as key user for the LiFe (License Fee) application, including Change Board representation and user support. Manage end-to-end license fee processes and ensure complete, audit-compliant documentation.

  • Collect, consolidate, and validate license-based revenue data to support rolling forecast calculations and identify variances.

  • Review Planisware data at project and supplier level to ensure high-quality forecasting inputs.

  • Analyze business performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending improvement actions. Drive process improvements through automation, standardization, and efficiency enhancements

  • Own and manage the customer-funded projects process.

  • Support MDG-F / MDG-C processes and manage purchase order activities.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance accounting or a related field from an accredited institution.

  • 3+ years of experience in similar roles.

  • Experience in ERP (SAP) module, NORRD, Power BI & Excel

  • Skilled in preparation, presentation, and understanding financial analysis and financial results as well as the implementation of action plans to improve financial analysis indicators.

  • Experienced with forecasts for month-end, quarter-end, and year-end.

  • Fluency in English enabling smooth communication is a must.

  • Demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to take responsibility for assigned tasks, work independently, and proactively drive deliverables to successful completion.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

IPU Leader Buy&Sell

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to supervise shift team’s progress against work plans as defined by Production management to ensure the proper use of machinery, equipment, and assembly lines within a production area. Each day, you will provide regular feedback and make recommendations to management regarding issues within the production line, including production line organization, shifting priorities, and possible critical situations. The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite.

This role is contributing to the IPU BUY&SELL in Quartino.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Helping management implement staff movements in case of vacations, illnesses, machine outages, or shifting priorities.

  • Reinforcing focus on volume, efficiency, and on-time delivery.

  • Assisting management and shift team in allocating, coordinating, and overseeing shift orders and work plan execution within production lines during the shift.

  • Serving as a leader during shifts to oversee cooperation and the resolution of technical/quality problems and logistic issues.

You will join a dynamic and collaborative team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Technical Diploma in Electronics, Electrical Technician, or a related field.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, was die Welt beherrscht.

In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, den Fortschritt des Schichtteams anhand der vom Produktionsmanagement festgelegten Arbeitspläne zu überwachen, um den ordnungsgemäßen Einsatz von Maschinen, Geräten und Montagelinien in einem Produktionsbereich sicherzustellen. Jeden Tag geben Sie regelmäßiges Feedback und geben Empfehlungen an das Management zu Problemen innerhalb der Produktionslinie, einschließlich der Organisation der Produktionslinie, wechselnder Prioritäten und möglicher kritischer Situationen. Sie werden auch Ihre Expertise präsentieren, indem Sie mit dem Bereichsleiter zusammenarbeiten, um eine effektive Arbeitsumgebung zu schaffen und die Produktionspläne und -qualität zu verbessern.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #LI-Onsite.

Diese Rolle trägt zum IPU-KAUF & VERKAUF in Quartino bei.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Unterstützung des Managements bei der Umsetzung von Mitarbeiterbewegungen im Falle von Ferien, Krankheiten, Maschinenausfällen oder wechselnden Prioritäten.

  • Stärkung des Fokus auf Volumen, Effizienz und pünktliche Lieferung.

    • Unterstützung des Management- und Schichtteams bei der Zuweisung, Koordination und Überwachung von Schichtaufträgen und der Ausführung von Arbeitsplänen innerhalb der Produktionslinien während der Schicht.

  • Führende Rolle in Schichten, um die Zusammenarbeit und die Lösung von technischen/qualitätsbezogenen Problemen und logistischen Problemen zu überwachen.

>

>

>

>

< Sie werden einem dynamischen und kollaborativen Team beitreten, in dem Sie gedeihen können.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Technisches Diplom in Elektronik, Elektrotechniker oder einem verwandten Bereich.

  • Kenntnisse von dreiphasigen elektrischen Systemen und Fähigkeit, elektrische und elektronische Schaltpläne zu lesen und zu interpretieren.

  • Kenntnisse in der Verwendung von elektrischen Testgeräten, einschließlich Multimetern, Wattmetern und Oszilloskopen.

  • Fähigkeit, effektiv in einer teamorientierten und funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung zu arbeiten. Vorherige Erfahrungen in der Fehlerbehebung und Fehlerdiagnose von elektrischen/elektronischen Systemen.

  • Kenntnisse von SAP sowie Vorherige Erfahrungen in der Arbeit mit Systemen der unterbrechungsfreien Stromversorgung.

  • Fluency in Italian

Mehr über uns:

ABB Elektrifizierung ist ein globaler Technologieführer, der die effiziente Nutzung von Strom vom Umspannwerk bis zur Steckdose ermöglicht. Mit mehr als 50.000 Mitarbeitern in 100 Ländern bringen wir Innovationen in die Elektroverteilung, Energiemanagementlösungen und -dienstleistungen. Wir suchen und arbeiten mit den klügsten Köpfen der Branche zusammen - von Universitäten über Startups bis hin zu technologieorientierten Unternehmen - und finden innovative Wege, um die Energieerzeugung zu dekarbonisieren und die Zirkularität zu verbessern.
ABB Elektrifizierung bietet führende Technologien, von Mittel- und Niederspannungsschaltanlagen bis hin zu elektrischen Komponenten und digitalen Geräten. Unsere Lösungen umfassen Produkte, Dienstleistungen, Software und Know-how für intelligente Gebäude, Industrie, Rechenzentren, Versorgungsunternehmen, Transport und mehr.
Unsere Produkte werden durch die digitalen Lösungen von ABB, einschließlich Augmented Reality und präventiver Wartung, erweitert. Diese digitalen Tools liefern datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse für mehr Energieeffizienz, Sicherheit und Komfort für Wohn-, Gewerbe- und Industriegebäude. In Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und Partnern lösen wir die größten Herausforderungen der Welt, um Effizienz, Zuverlässigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit zu fördern.

Dieser Rekrutierungsprozess wird geleitet von Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead, ABB Schweiz.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position se rapporte à:

IPU Leader Buy&Sell

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité de superviser les progrès de l'équipe de travail par rapport aux plans de travail tels que définis par la direction de la production afin d'assurer l'utilisation appropriée des machines, des équipements et des chaînes de montage dans une zone de production. Chaque jour, vous ferez régulièrement des commentaires et formulerez des recommandations à la direction au sujet des enjeux de la chaîne de production, y compris l'organisation de la chaîne de production, l'évolution des priorités et d'éventuelles situations critiques. Vous présenterez également votre expertise en collaborant avec le superviseur de l'unité pour créer un environnement de travail efficace et renforcer les calendriers de production et la qualité.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-Onsite.

Ce rôle contribue à l'UIP BUY&SELL in Quartino.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Aider la direction à mettre en oeuvre les mouvements de personnel en cas de vacances, de maladies, de pannes de machines ou de changement de priorités.

  • Rendre l'accent sur le volume, l'efficacité et la livraison à temps.

  • Aider l'équipe de gestion et de quart à répartir, coordonner et superviser les ordres de quarts et l'exécution du plan de travail dans les lignes de production pendant le quart.

  • À titre de chef de file pendant les quarts de travail pour superviser la coopération et la résolution des problèmes techniques/de qualité et des problèmes logistiques.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique et collaborative, où vous pourrez prospérer.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Diplôme technique en électronique, en électrotechnique ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • Connaissance des systèmes électriques en trois phases et capacité de lire et d'interpréter les schémas électriques et électroniques.

  • Compétence dans l'utilisation d'équipement d'essai électrique, y compris les multimètres, les wattsmètres et les oscilloscopes.

  • Capacité de travailler efficacement dans un environnement axé sur l'équipe et interfonctionnel. Expérience antérieure en matière de dépannage et de diagnostic de défaillance des systèmes électriques/électroniques.

  • Connaissance du SAP ainsi qu'expérience antérieure de travail avec les systèmes d'alimentation électrique non interruptible (UPS).

  • Fluency in Italian

Pour en savoir plus sur nous :

ABB L'électrification est un leader technologique mondial qui permet une utilisation efficace de l'électricité de la sous-station à la prise. Avec plus de 50 000 employés dans 100 pays, nous apportons de l'innovation dans la distribution électrique, les solutions de gestion de l'énergie et les services. Nous recherchons et nous collaborons avec les esprits les plus brillants de l'industrie - des universités aux start-up aux entreprises axées sur la technologie - en trouvant des moyens novateurs de décarboniser la production d'énergie et d'améliorer la circularité.
ABB L'électrification offre des technologies de pointe, depuis le commutateur à moyenne et basse tension jusqu'aux composants électriques et aux appareils numériques. Nos solutions intègrent des produits, des services, des logiciels et une expertise pour les bâtiments intelligents, l'industrie, les centres de données, les services publics, le transport et plus encore.
Nos produits sont améliorés par les solutions numériques d'ABB, y compris la réalité augmentée et la maintenance préventive. Ces outils numériques fournissent des données permettant d'accroître l'efficacité énergétique, la sûreté, la sécurité et le confort des bâtiments résidentiels, commerciaux et industriels. En collaboration avec nos clients et nos partenaires, nous résolvons les plus grands défis mondiaux pour stimuler l'efficacité, la fiabilité et la durabilité.

Ce processus de recrutement est dirigé par Ceren Özen, chef d'équipe d'acquisition de talents, ABB Suisse.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Co-Head Corporate Procurement

__

ABB Corporate Procurement is looking for a Procurement Category Specialist for HR Services (Recruiting, Temporary Labor, Training and others), Marketing and Professional Services (Consulting, Legal, Financial, Tax Services and others) with hands-on and international experience.

Our Corporate Procurement function serves internal stakeholders across ABB’s Headquarter, while also drivining Group-wide iniatives and strategic activites that impact the broader organization.

This is a unique opportunity to actively contribute to shaping the future of our Corporate Procurement function and to grow together with a highly experienced and collaborative team: Seize the opportunity and be part of this journey!

The work model for the role is: hybrid

The role is open globally, with a preference for CET locations such as: Italy, Switzerland, Spain, Portugal, India, Poland.

Your • Responsibilities:

  • Execute the implementation of Procurement Strategy in alignment with the relevant category team and business stakeholders

  • Perform purchasing activities according to required needs, specifications, price, delivery schedule and contractual terms

  • Manage cooperation with a portfolio of ABB approved suppliers and oversee their performance to ensure performance, quality and compliance.

  • Provide market insights, analyze and evaluate bids to determine the optimal value and negotiate agreements with key suppliers

  • Ensuring all sourcing events are conducted through the appropriate eSourcing tools, maintaining full control and integrity of supplier master data

  • Identify and qualify new suppliers in collaboration with internal stakeholders to support business needs, innovation and competitiveness

  • Initiate and implement cost-out programs and optimization initiatives to achieve financial targets and drive process improvements

  • Coordinate procurement orders and deliveries including maintaining accurate reports, updates and documentation within relevant systems

Your qualifications:

  • Ideally 5 years of experience in Procurement – preferably in Indirect Services Procurement within the categories of Services (HR, Marketing and Professional Services) or equivalent extensive experience working directly in the HR, Consulting, Legal and/or Marketing category for which the role is intended to support

  • Strong negotiation skills a solution‑oriented, analytical mindset

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to represent Corporate Procurement across all seniority levels

  • Strong team player while also able to work independently within allocated areas

  • Comfortable working with legal and contractual terms and language

  • Fluency in spoken and written English

  • Proactively contributes as a team member to achieving team goals

  • Responds positively to new situations and challenges, demonstrating adaptability and professionalism

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

We are looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our R&D team and contribute to the development of modern desktop applications built on the Microsoft .NET platform. In this role, you will design, develop, and enhance business-critical software solutions while working closely with cross-functional teams.

You will apply software engineering best practices to deliver scalable, maintainable, and high-quality applications that support ABB's technology and innovation objectives.

You will work closely with other developers to design, develop, test, and improve business-critical applications while following modern software engineering practices.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid (#LI-Hybrid)
Preferred location: Quartino, Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance desktop applications using C#, .NET, and WPF technologies
  • Collaborate with software engineers, domain experts, and stakeholders to design and implement high-quality software solutions
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve software issues while continuously improving application performance and reliability
  • Contribute to software architecture, code reviews, and development best practices to ensure maintainable and scalable solutions

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience in software development using C# and the .NET ecosystem
  • Experience with WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation) and solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles
  • Knowledge of software design patterns, application architecture, MVVM, dependency injection, and modern .NET development practices
  • Familiarity with ASP.NET applications, REST APIs, source control systems (e.g., Git), and software development best practices such as Clean Code and Clean Architecture
  • Basic understanding of DevOps concepts, CI/CD practices, testing methodologies, and Agile/Scrum ways of working
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment, and professional proficiency in English

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on modern .NET desktop applications and contribute to selected web-based solutions
  • Collaborative and supportive development environment
  • Professional growth and continuous learning opportunities
  • Exposure to software architecture, engineering concepts, and best development practices

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Scientist (Senior) Power Electronic Converters 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A talented, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Simulate, compare, and optimize power electronic topologies and converter systems for a wide range of applications, including system-level studies and performance evaluations

  • Collaborate closely with colleagues within the team and across disciplines, sharing expertise, mentoring team members, and contributing to a culture of innovation and continuous learning

  • Design, implement, commission, and experimentally validate advanced power converter systems, from proof-of-concept models to full-scale demonstrators

  • Develop and advance innovative power electronic topologies, control strategies, and converter solutions for emerging applications

• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in Engineering, or a Master's degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience in power electronic converter design, optimization, and testing, or in system-level studies, including architecture trade-offs for large power converters, scaling across varying voltage and power levels, and/or grid interactions under dynamic operating conditions

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken

    Expertise in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

  • Hands-on experience in commissioning and testing full-scale converter systems, including back-to-back power flow setups

  • Experience in the design, implementation, and validation of high-power medium-voltage converters and/or grid-connected three-phase inverters

  • Strong knowledge of applied control theory and power converter control, including experience with embedded hardware development and programming of FPGAs (VHDL) and/or microcontrollers for power electronic applications

  • Experience in optimization-driven power stage design, supported by simulation and experimental validation

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snelle e più pulite.E ogni persona qui fa accadere. You.ll essere autorizzato a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo.

Questa posizione è riportata al seguente indirizzo:

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: #LI-Hybrid

Responsabilità

Le principali responsabilità comprendono:

- Simulare, confrontare e ottimizzare le topologie elettroniche di potenza e i sistemi di convertitore per un'ampia gamma di applicazioni, compresi studi a livello di sistema e valutazioni delle prestazioni - Collaborare strettamente con i colleghi all'interno del team e tra le discipline, condividere competenze, membri del team di mentoring e contribuire a una cultura dell'innovazione e dell'apprendimento continuo - Progettazione, attuazione, commissione e convalida sperimentale di sistemi avanzati di convertitori di potenza, dai modelli proof of concept ai dimostranti su larga scala - Sviluppare e promuovere tecnologie innovative di topologie elettroniche di potenza, strategie di controllo,

soluzioni e convertitori per applicazioni emergenti

Requisiti

Qualificazioni per il ruolo

- Dottorato di ricerca in Ingegneria, o laurea magistrale con almeno 3 anni di esperienza nella progettazione, ottimizzazione e test di conversione elettronica di potenza, o in studi a livello di sistema, compresi i trade-off di architettura per convertitori di potenza di grandi dimensioni, scalando attraverso diversi livelli di tensione e potenza, e/o interazioni di rete in condizioni operative dinamiche - Fluenza in inglese, sia scritto che parlato

È altamente auspicabile una competenza in uno o più dei seguenti settori:

- Esperienza pratica nella messa in servizio e nella prova di sistemi di convertitori a scala intera, compresi i setup di flusso di potenza back-to-back - Esperienza nella progettazione, implementazione e validazione di convertitori ad alta potenza a media tensione e/o inverter trifase collegati alla rete - Conoscenza forte della teoria del controllo applicato e del controllo dei convertitori di potenza, compresa l'esperienza nello sviluppo hardware incorporato e nella programmazione di FPGA (VHDL) e/o microcontrollori per applicazioni elettroniche di potenza - Esperienza nella progettazione di stadi di potenza a guida di ottimizzazione, supportata da simulazione e validazione sperimentale

Chi siamo

Presso il centro di ricerca ABB di Baden-Dättwil, in prossimità di Zurigo, lavoriamo su tecnologie emozionanti che plasmano il futuro dei nostri prodotti. I nostri team di ricerca internazionali si concentrano su Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, e Switching.

Abbiamo apprezzato persone provenienti da diversi background. Potrebbe essere questa la vostra storia? Applicare oggi o visitare www.abb.com per saperne di più su di noi e conoscere l'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Contatto

Il processo di reclutamento è guidato da Pedro Labian, Partner di Tant presso ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Data di nascita: 19.12.1956

Pronto a fare un impatto?

Applica oggi o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
R&D Team Lead

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

Responsibilities

The main responsibilities include

- Simulate, compare, and optimize power electronic topologies and converter systems for a wide range of applications, including system-level studies and performance evaluations
- Collaborate closely with colleagues within the team and across disciplines, sharing expertise, mentoring team members, and contributing to a culture of innovation and continuous learning
- Design, implement, commission, and experimentally validate advanced power converter systems, from proof-of-concept models to full-scale demonstrators
- Develop and advance innovative power electronic topologies, control strategies, and converter solutions for emerging applications

Requirements

Qualifications for the role

- PhD in Engineering, or a Master's degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience in power electronic converter design, optimization, and testing, or in system-level studies, including architecture trade-offs for large power converters, scaling across varying voltage and power levels, and/or grid interactions under dynamic operating conditions
- Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Expertise in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

- Hands-on experience in commissioning and testing full-scale converter systems, including back-to-back power flow setups
- Experience in the design, implementation, and validation of high-power medium-voltage converters and/or grid-connected three-phase inverters
- Strong knowledge of applied control theory and power converter control, including experience with embedded hardware development and programming of FPGAs (VHDL) and/or microcontrollers for power electronic applications
- Experience in optimization-driven power stage design, supported by simulation and experimental validation

About Us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Contact

The recruitment process is being led by Pedro Labian, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

ABB: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Warenbezeichnung

Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu werden – und das macht jeder hier. Sie werden dazu ermächtigt, zu führen, zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam erzeugen.

Diese Position berichtet an: F&E Team Lead

Das Modell der Rolle ist: #LI-Hybrid

- Nein.

Zuständigkeiten

Die Hauptverantwortung umfasst

- Simulation, Vergleich und Optimierung von Leistungselektronik-Topologien und Konvertersystemen für eine Vielzahl von Anwendungen, einschließlich Systemstudien und Leistungsbewertungen - enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen innerhalb des Teams und in allen Disziplinen, Austausch von Fachwissen, Mentoring-Teammitglieder und Beitrag zu einer Kultur der Innovation und des kontinuierlichen Lernens - Design, Implementierung, Kommission und experimentell validieren fortgeschrittene Leistungswandlersysteme, von Proof-of-Concept-Modellen bis hin zu umfassenden Demonstratoren - Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung innovativer Leistungselektronik-Topologien, Steuerungsstrategien,

und Konverterlösungen für neue Anwendungen

Anforderungen

Qualifikationen für die Rolle

- Doktortitel in Ingenieurwissenschaften oder Master-Abschluss mit mindestens 3 Jahren einschlägiger Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Optimierung und Erprobung von Stromwandlern oder in Systemstudien, einschließlich Architektur-Austausch für große Stromwandler, Skalierung über unterschiedliche Spannungs- und Leistungsstufen und/oder Netzinteraktionen unter dynamischen Betriebsbedingungen - Fluency in English, sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen

Ein Fachwissen in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche ist sehr wünschenswert:

- Erfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme und Erprobung von Vollformatwandlern, einschließlich Back-to-back-Stromfluss-Setups - Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Implementierung und Validierung von Hochleistungs-Mittelspannungswandlern und/oder netzgebundenen Dreiphasen-Wechselrichtern - Starkes Wissen über angewandte Steuerungstheorie und Power-Konverter-Steuerung, einschließlich Erfahrung mit Embedded Hardware Entwicklung und Programmierung von FPGAs (VHDL) und/oder Microcontrollern für stromelektronische Anwendungen - Erfahrung in der optimierungsgesteuerten Leistungsstufen-Design, unterstützt durch Simulation und experimentelle Validierung

Über uns

Am ABB-Forschungszentrum Baden-Dättwil in Zürich arbeiten wir an spannenden Technologien, die die Zukunft unserer Produkte prägen. Unsere internationalen Forschungsteams konzentrieren sich auf die Bereiche Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems und Switching.

Wir schätzen Menschen aus verschiedenen Hintergründen. Könnte dies Ihre Geschichte sein? Bewerben Sie sich heute oder besuchen Sie www.abb.com, um mehr über uns zu erfahren und über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Ansprechpartner

Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Pedro Labian, Talent Partner bei ABB Switzerland Ltd. geleitet.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres, et chaque personne ici fait cela. Vous serez habilité à diriger, soutenu pour grandir et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à diriger ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de : Chef d'équipe de R-D

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: #LI-Hybrid

Responsabilités

Les principales responsabilités sont notamment les suivantes:

- Simuler, comparer et optimiser les topologies et les systèmes de convertisseurs électroniques de puissance pour une large gamme d'applications, y compris les études et les évaluations de performance au niveau du système - Collaborer étroitement avec les collègues de l'équipe et de toutes les disciplines, partager les compétences, former les membres de l'équipe et contribuer à une culture d'innovation et d'apprentissage continu - Conception, mise en œuvre, mise en service et validation expérimentale des systèmes de convertisseurs de puissance avancés, des modèles de démonstration aux manifestants à grande échelle - Développer et faire progresser les topologies et les stratégies de contrôle électroniques de puissance innovantes,

et des solutions de conversion pour les applications émergentes

Besoins

Qualifications pour le rôle

- Doctorat en génie ou maîtrise avec au moins 3 ans d'expérience pertinente en conception, optimisation et essais de convertisseurs électroniques de puissance, ou dans des études au niveau du système, y compris des compromis d'architecture pour les gros convertisseurs de puissance, l'échelle à travers des niveaux de tension et de puissance variables, et/ou des interactions de réseau dans des conditions de fonctionnement dynamiques - Fluence en anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée

Une expertise dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants est hautement souhaitable :

- Expérience pratique de la mise en service et de l'essai de systèmes de convertisseur à grande échelle, y compris les configurations de débit de puissance de retour en arrière - Expérience de la conception, de la mise en œuvre et de la validation de convertisseurs à moyenne-volte de haute puissance et/ou d'onduleurs triphasés reliés au réseau - Connaissance approfondie de la théorie appliquée de contrôle et de la commande de convertisseur de puissance, y compris l'expérience du développement matériel intégré et de la programmation des FPGA (VHDL) et/ou des microcontrôleurs pour les applications électroniques de puissance - Expérience de la conception de la phase de puissance à optimisation, soutenue par la simulation et la validation expérimentale

À propos de nous

Au centre de recherche ABB de Bade-Dättwil, à proximité de Zurich, nous travaillons sur des technologies passionnantes qui façonnent l'avenir de nos produits. Nos équipes de recherche internationales se concentrent sur l'électronique de puissance, le stockage de l'énergie, les systèmes intelligents et le commutateur.

Nous apprécions les gens de différents horizons. Cela pourrait-il être votre histoire? Postulez aujourd'hui ou visitez www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur nous et découvrez l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

Personne à contacter

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Manager Process Industries Switzerland (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Manager - E2E

__

In this role, you own the Trade Compliance framework for the Local Business Line (LBL) and are accountable for establishing, implementing, and continuously improving the policies, processes, controls, and governance required to ensure compliant execution of our global business activities. You ensure that all international business transactions, project deliveries, imports, exports, cross-border shipments, and related trade activities are conducted in accordance with ABB's Global Trade Program and applicable customs, export control, sanctions, and origin regulations. As the LBL's Trade Compliance authority, you define and maintain the operational trade compliance framework. You establish clear processes, responsibilities, controls, and escalation mechanisms and ensure effective implementation across all relevant functions. You drive the integration of trade compliance requirements into daily operations and act as the main point for complex compliance matters, regulatory changes, and risk mitigation. You are further responsible for developing, documenting, and maintaining procedures and training programs related to export controls, sanctions, customs, and origin management.

Working model is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop, improve and implement processes of LBL’s customs procedures, origin management, sanction lists screening, dual-use classification and export controls.

  • Functionally lead trade compliance resources in the LBL.

  • Lead and oversee Trade Compliance within the Local Business Line (LBL), including the implementation and continuous improvement of ABB’s Trade Compliance Program, internal directives, internal control system, local trade reviews, self-audits, and corrective actions.

  • Provide expert guidance and training on customs, origin, export control, and sanctions compliance, supporting the LBL, coordinating trade compliance resources and support functions, and maintaining strong alignment with key stakeholders such as CTCO, TCS, PCE, declarants, and logistics teams.

  • Drive Trade Compliance in day-to-day operations and complex projects, including risk assessments, internal checks, master data and supplier-related compliance requirements, and regular updates to stakeholders on implementation progress and relevant regulatory changes.

  • Advise and drive all trade compliance matters in LBL’s complex projects to different countries


What we are looking for:

  • Degree as a Foreign Trade Specialist / Manager or Export Control / Customs Compliance Officer with at least 8 years of experience in a relevant field (Senior Trade Compliance or Legal/Compliance background)

  • Excellent experience in free trade and preferential origins as well as in trade compliance matters

  • Solid knowledge in Swiss (GKV), EU and US (EAR) dual-use and sanctions regulations

  • Experience in an industry with large project businesses in various countries and ability as a people leader and solution-oriented team player

  • SAP and SAP GTS E4H experiences

  • Fluent in English, German is a plus

More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry- specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment. Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu führen, was die Welt beherrscht.

In dieser Rolle sind Sie Eigentümer des Trade Compliance Frameworks für die Local Business Line (LBL) und sind verantwortlich für die Festlegung, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Richtlinien, Prozesse, Kontrollen und Governance, die erforderlich sind, um eine konforme Ausführung unserer globalen Geschäftsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten. Sie stellen sicher, dass alle internationalen Geschäftstransaktionen, Projektlieferungen, Importe, Exporte, grenzüberschreitende Sendungen und damit verbundene Handelsaktivitäten in Übereinstimmung mit dem Global Trade Program von ABB und den geltenden Zoll-, Exportkontroll-, Sanktions- und Ursprungsbestimmungen durchgeführt werden. Als Trade Compliance Authority der LBL definieren und pflegen Sie das operative Trade Compliance Framework. Sie legen klare Prozesse, Verantwortlichkeiten, Kontrollen und Eskalationsmechanismen fest und gewährleisten eine effektive Umsetzung über alle relevanten Funktionen hinweg. Sie treiben die Integration von Trade-Compliance- • Anforderungen in den täglichen Betrieb voran und sind der wichtigste Punkt für komplexe Compliance-Angelegenheiten, regulatorische Änderungen und Risikominderung. Sie sind ferner verantwortlich für die Entwicklung, Dokumentation und Aufrechterhaltung von Verfahren und Schulungsprogrammen im Zusammenhang mit Exportkontrollen, Sanktionen, Zoll und Ursprungsmanagement.

Arbeitsmodell ist: #LI-Hybrid


Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Entwicklung, Verbesserung und Implementierung von Prozessen der Zollverfahren von LBL, des Ursprungsmanagements, des Sanktionslisten-Screenings, der Klassifizierung von Dual-Use-Listen und der Exportkontrollen.

  • Funktional führen Sie die Compliance-Ressourcen für den Handel im LBL.

  • Führen und überwachen Sie Trade Compliance innerhalb des lokalen Geschäftsbereichs (LBL), einschließlich der Implementierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Trade Compliance-Programms von ABB, interne Richtlinien, internes Kontrollsystem, lokale Handelsüberprüfungen, Selbstprüfungen und Korrekturmaßnahmen.

  • Bereitstellung von fachkundiger Beratung und Schulung zu Zoll-, Ursprungs-, Exportkontrolle und Sanktions-Compliance, Unterstützung der LBL, Koordination von Trade-Compliance-Ressourcen und -Support-Funktionen und Aufrechterhaltung einer starken Abstimmung mit wichtigen Stakeholdern wie CTCO, TCS, PCE, Deklaranten und Logistikteams.

  • Drive Trade Compliance im täglichen Betrieb und in komplexen Projekten, einschließlich Risikobewertungen, interner Kontrollen, Stammdaten und lieferantenbezogenen Compliance- • Anforderungen sowie regelmäßige Aktualisierungen der Stakeholder über den Umsetzungsfortschritt und relevante regulatorische Änderungen.

  • Beratung und Steuerung aller Trade-Compliance-Angelegenheiten in LBLs komplexen Projekten in verschiedenen Ländern


Was wir suchen:
