jobs.title: (80 - 100%) Engineering Change Manager Service
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure that change notifications by the Agile teams of the UPS product lines consider the serviceability of the products. You will engage with the change managers of the Agile teams and the stakeholders within Service on a daily basis.

This role contributes to the Global Service Engineering team in Quartino. The main stakeholders include change managers from the Agile teams of the UPS product lines in Quartino, service professionals responsible for technical support, documentation, and spare parts, as well as supply chain specialists responsible for spare part creation and stock management.

You will join a newly formed Service Engineering team, where you will have the opportunity to thrive.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing new ECN (engineering change notices) for potential impact on Service
  • Maintaining a tracker for ECN potentially affecting Service
  • Run the meetings where Service stakeholders discuss ECN impact and suggest changes to the change leaders
  • Track the updates to the ECN based on Service stakeholder consensus and approve acceptable ECN
  • Track the execution of Service implementation of the ECN (Service News, Spare part (list) updates, information to global technical support)
  • Providing technical support and solving problems in own expertise area via remote or on-site service in any Service category
  • You will support the change managers pro-actively to improve the correctness, completeness, and effectiveness of the Service aspects of the ECN

• Qualifications for the role:

  • A bachelor’s degree, diploma, or higher academic qualification in Electrical or Electronic Engineering
  • At least 5 years of experience in similar roles, or 10 years of experience in UPS development or service roles
  • Experience with the product lines manufactured in Quartino
  • Experience with change management process and related documentation
  • Experience in the Windchill change management system
  • Proficiency in both verbal and written English communication (B2 level or higher) Knowledge of any other language is a welcome asset

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Power Electronics Engineer for Traction Projects (m/f/d) (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Team Leader Power Electronics Engineering

__

Power Electronics Engineer for Traction Projects (m/f/d) (80 - 100%)

Are you ready to take your passion for traction power electronics to new heights? Whether you're diving into designing powerful traction systems for passenger trains, metros, trams, next generation locomotives, or innovative platform products, this is your chance to make an impact!

Bring your enthusiasm and expertise in power electronics and explore a world of exciting opportunities. You'll be working alongside global teams in engineering, production, R&D, and project management, all united in pushing the boundaries of technology.

We believe in the power of inclusion, gender equality, and building a diverse environment where every voice is valued. Whether you're expanding your skills or building on past experiences, your unique perspective is essential to driving innovation forward. We’re eager to see what you’ll bring to the table; fresh ideas come from diverse minds.

Reporting to the Power Electronics Engineering Manager, you’ll be part of a team focused on delivering traction projects efficiently, and with high quality through close collaboration, technical excellence, and inclusivity. Ready for the journey?

Key • Responsibilities:

  • Advanced Systems Engineering: Design traction power electronics converter and energy storage systems (ESS), while ensuring their seamless integration within vehicles. Your work will align with customer needs, industry standards, and internal specifications.

  • Testing & Validation: Lead the specification, execution, analysis, and documentation of Type and Qualification tests to ensure robust system performance, focusing on traction converters and ESS for enhanced energy efficiency.

  • Technical leadership: Develop deep expertise in core power engineering competencies, components, or tools to provide technical guidance for your peers. Optimize design processes and customer solutions independently or by collaborating in cross-functional specialist teams.

  • Product Standardization: Contribute to the evolution of our traction product families through standardization, and continuous improvements. Leverage your expertise to drive innovation in the integration of traction converters with ESS.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Power Electronics Expertise: A qualified Power Electronics/Electrical Engineer with a solid background in power electronics design and engineering. Experience with traction converters and energy storage systems is an advantage.

  • Curiosity & Continuous Learning: Eager to continuously expand technical expertise, drive continuous improvement, share knowledge with the team, fostering a culture of growth and collaboration.

  • Problem Solver & Team Player: A proactive individual who thrives on solving complex challenges and takes ownership of their tasks, while also being an effective player in an inclusive team.

  • Fluent Communicator: Clear and efficient communication in English is essential, both written and spoken. German language skills are a strong advantage.

  • Willingness to Travel: Occasional travel opportunities to support projects.

Join us and elevate your career in the thrilling world of rail vehicle drive systems! This is your opportunity to thrive and grow while making a meaningful impact on the future of sustainable transportation!

Power Electronics Engineer for Traction Projects (m/f/d) (80 - 100%)

Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft für Traktionsleistungselektronik auf ein neues Level zu heben? Ob Sie leistungsstarke Traktionssysteme für Personenzüge, Metros, Straßenbahnen, Lokomotiven der nächsten Generation oder innovative Plattformprodukte entwickeln – hier haben Sie die Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen!

Bringen Sie Ihre Begeisterung und Ihr Fachwissen in der Leistungselektronik ein und entdecken Sie eine Welt voller spannender Möglichkeiten. Sie arbeiten Hand in Hand mit globalen Teams aus den Bereichen Engineering, Produktion, F&E und Projektmanagement – alle vereint mit dem Ziel, technologische Grenzen zu verschieben.

Wir glauben an die Kraft der Inklusion, Gleichstellung der Geschlechter und an den Aufbau eines vielfältigen Umfelds, in dem jede Stimme zählt. Egal ob Sie neue Fähigkeiten entwickeln oder auf bestehenden Erfahrungen aufbauen – Ihre einzigartige Perspektive ist entscheidend, um Innovation voranzutreiben. Wir sind gespannt, was Sie einbringen werden – denn frische Ideen entstehen aus vielfältigen Köpfen.

Sie berichten an den Engineering Manager Power Electronics und sind Teil eines Teams, das sich auf die effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung von Traktionsprojekten konzentriert – durch enge Zusammenarbeit, technische Exzellenz und Inklusion. Bereit für die Reise?

Hauptaufgaben:

  • Fortgeschrittenes Systems Engineering: Entwicklung von Leistungselektronik-Konvertern und Energiespeichersystemen (ESS) für Traktionsanwendungen sowie Sicherstellung ihrer nahtlosen Integration in Fahrzeuge. Ihre Arbeit orientiert sich an Kundenanforderungen, Industriestandards und internen Spezifikationen.

  • Testen & Validierung: Leitung der Spezifikation, Durchführung, Analyse und Dokumentation von Typ- und Qualifikationstests zur Sicherstellung einer robusten Systemleistung – mit Fokus auf Traktionskonverter und ESS für verbesserte Energieeffizienz.

  • Technische Führung: Aufbau tiefgehender Expertise in zentralen Power-Engineering-Kompetenzen, Komponenten oder Tools, um Ihre Kollegen fachlich zu unterstützen. Optimierung von Designprozessen und Kundenlösungen – eigenständig oder in cross-funktionalen Spezialistenteams.

  • Produktstandardisierung: Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Traktionsproduktfamilien durch Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Nutzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen, um Innovation in der Integration von Traktionskonvertern mit ESS voranzutreiben.

• Anforderungen:

  • Expertise in Leistungselektronik: Qualifizierter Ingenieur im Bereich Leistungselektronik / Elektrotechnik mit fundiertem Hintergrund in Design und Engineering. Erfahrung mit Traktionskonvertern und Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.

  • Neugier & kontinuierliches Lernen: Begeisterung für den stetigen Ausbau technischer Expertise, Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und Weitergabe von Wissen im Team – für eine Kultur des Wachstums und der Zusammenarbeit.

  • Problemlöser & Teamplayer: Eine proaktive Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Herausforderungen liebt, Verantwortung für ihre • Aufgaben übernimmt und gleichzeitig ein effektiver Teil eines inklusiven Teams ist.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Klare und effiziente Kommunikation auf Englisch ist unerlässlich – schriftlich wie mündlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein klarer Vorteil.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Team Leader Power Electronics Engineering

__

Power Electronics Engineer for Traction Projects (m/f/d) (80 - 100%)

Are you ready to take your passion for traction power electronics to new heights? Whether you're diving into designing powerful traction systems for passenger trains, metros, trams, next generation locomotives, or innovative platform products, this is your chance to make an impact!

Bring your enthusiasm and expertise in power electronics and explore a world of exciting opportunities. You'll be working alongside global teams in engineering, production, R&D, and project management, all united in pushing the boundaries of technology.

We believe in the power of inclusion, gender equality, and building a diverse environment where every voice is valued. Whether you're expanding your skills or building on past experiences, your unique perspective is essential to driving innovation forward. We’re eager to see what you’ll bring to the table; fresh ideas come from diverse minds.

Reporting to the Power Electronics Engineering Manager, you’ll be part of a team focused on delivering traction projects efficiently, and with high quality through close collaboration, technical excellence, and inclusivity. Ready for the journey?

Key • Responsibilities:

  • Advanced Systems Engineering: Design traction power electronics converter and energy storage systems (ESS), while ensuring their seamless integration within vehicles. Your work will align with customer needs, industry standards, and internal specifications.

  • Testing & Validation: Lead the specification, execution, analysis, and documentation of Type and Qualification tests to ensure robust system performance, focusing on traction converters and ESS for enhanced energy efficiency.

  • Technical leadership: Develop deep expertise in core power engineering competencies, components, or tools to provide technical guidance for your peers. Optimize design processes and customer solutions independently or by collaborating in cross-functional specialist teams.

  • Product Standardization: Contribute to the evolution of our traction product families through standardization, and continuous improvements. Leverage your expertise to drive innovation in the integration of traction converters with ESS.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Power Electronics Expertise: A qualified Power Electronics/Electrical Engineer with a solid background in power electronics design and engineering. Experience with traction converters and energy storage systems is an advantage.

  • Curiosity & Continuous Learning: Eager to continuously expand technical expertise, drive continuous improvement, share knowledge with the team, fostering a culture of growth and collaboration.

  • Problem Solver & Team Player: A proactive individual who thrives on solving complex challenges and takes ownership of their tasks, while also being an effective player in an inclusive team.

  • Fluent Communicator: Clear and efficient communication in English is essential, both written and spoken. German language skills are a strong advantage.

  • Willingness to Travel: Occasional travel opportunities to support projects.

Join us and elevate your career in the thrilling world of rail vehicle drive systems! This is your opportunity to thrive and grow while making a meaningful impact on the future of sustainable transportation!

Power Electronics Engineer for Traction Projects (m/f/d) (80 - 100%)

Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft für Traktionsleistungselektronik auf ein neues Level zu heben? Ob Sie leistungsstarke Traktionssysteme für Personenzüge, Metros, Straßenbahnen, Lokomotiven der nächsten Generation oder innovative Plattformprodukte entwickeln – hier haben Sie die Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen!

Bringen Sie Ihre Begeisterung und Ihr Fachwissen in der Leistungselektronik ein und entdecken Sie eine Welt voller spannender Möglichkeiten. Sie arbeiten Hand in Hand mit globalen Teams aus den Bereichen Engineering, Produktion, F&E und Projektmanagement – alle vereint mit dem Ziel, technologische Grenzen zu verschieben.

Wir glauben an die Kraft der Inklusion, Gleichstellung der Geschlechter und an den Aufbau eines vielfältigen Umfelds, in dem jede Stimme zählt. Egal ob Sie neue Fähigkeiten entwickeln oder auf bestehenden Erfahrungen aufbauen – Ihre einzigartige Perspektive ist entscheidend, um Innovation voranzutreiben. Wir sind gespannt, was Sie einbringen werden – denn frische Ideen entstehen aus vielfältigen Köpfen.

Sie berichten an den Engineering Manager Power Electronics und sind Teil eines Teams, das sich auf die effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung von Traktionsprojekten konzentriert – durch enge Zusammenarbeit, technische Exzellenz und Inklusion. Bereit für die Reise?

Hauptaufgaben:

  • Fortgeschrittenes Systems Engineering: Entwicklung von Leistungselektronik-Konvertern und Energiespeichersystemen (ESS) für Traktionsanwendungen sowie Sicherstellung ihrer nahtlosen Integration in Fahrzeuge. Ihre Arbeit orientiert sich an Kundenanforderungen, Industriestandards und internen Spezifikationen.

  • Testen & Validierung: Leitung der Spezifikation, Durchführung, Analyse und Dokumentation von Typ- und Qualifikationstests zur Sicherstellung einer robusten Systemleistung – mit Fokus auf Traktionskonverter und ESS für verbesserte Energieeffizienz.

  • Technische Führung: Aufbau tiefgehender Expertise in zentralen Power-Engineering-Kompetenzen, Komponenten oder Tools, um Ihre Kollegen fachlich zu unterstützen. Optimierung von Designprozessen und Kundenlösungen – eigenständig oder in cross-funktionalen Spezialistenteams.

  • Produktstandardisierung: Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Traktionsproduktfamilien durch Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Nutzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen, um Innovation in der Integration von Traktionskonvertern mit ESS voranzutreiben.

• Anforderungen:

  • Expertise in Leistungselektronik: Qualifizierter Ingenieur im Bereich Leistungselektronik / Elektrotechnik mit fundiertem Hintergrund in Design und Engineering. Erfahrung mit Traktionskonvertern und Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.

  • Neugier & kontinuierliches Lernen: Begeisterung für den stetigen Ausbau technischer Expertise, Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und Weitergabe von Wissen im Team – für eine Kultur des Wachstums und der Zusammenarbeit.

  • Problemlöser & Teamplayer: Eine proaktive Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Herausforderungen liebt, Verantwortung für ihre • Aufgaben übernimmt und gleichzeitig ein effektiver Teil eines inklusiven Teams ist.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Klare und effiziente Kommunikation auf Englisch ist unerlässlich – schriftlich wie mündlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein klarer Vorteil.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Gelegentliche Reisen zur Projektunterstützung sind möglich.

The recruitment process is supported by Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus rationnelle et plus propre. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Chef d'équipe Électronique Power Engineering

Ingénieur Électronique Power pour les projets de traction (m/f/d) (80 - 100%)

Êtes-vous prêt à prendre votre passion pour l'électronique de traction à de nouvelles hauteurs? Que vous plongez dans la conception de puissants systèmes de traction pour les trains de voyageurs, les métros, les tramways, les locomotives de prochaine génération ou les produits de plate-forme innovants, c'est votre chance de faire un impact!

Apportez votre enthousiasme et votre expertise en électronique de puissance et explorez un monde d'opportunités passionnantes. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'équipes mondiales en ingénierie, production, R-D et gestion de projets, toutes unies pour repousser les limites de la technologie.

Nous croyons au pouvoir de l'inclusion, à l'égalité entre les sexes et à l'édification d'un environnement diversifié où chaque voix est appréciée. Que vous développiez vos compétences ou que vous utilisiez des expériences passées, votre perspective unique est essentielle pour faire avancer l'innovation. Nous sommes impatients de voir ce que vous apporterez à la table; de nouvelles idées viennent de divers esprits.

Reporter au directeur du génie de l'électronique de puissance, vous ferez partie d'une équipe axée sur la prestation efficace des projets de traction, et avec une qualité élevée grâce à une collaboration étroite, l'excellence technique et l'inclusivité. Prêt pour le voyage?

Key • Responsabilités :

  • Ingénierie des systèmes avancés : Concevoir des convertisseurs électroniques de puissance de traction et des systèmes de stockage d'énergie (ESS), tout en assurant leur intégration transparente dans les véhicules. Votre travail sera conforme aux besoins des clients, aux normes de l'industrie et aux spécifications internes.

  • Test et validation: Diriger les spécifications, l'exécution, l'analyse et la documentation des tests de type et de qualification afin d'assurer une performance robuste du système, en mettant l'accent sur les convertisseurs de traction et le SSE pour améliorer l'efficacité énergétique.

  • Leadership technique: Développez une expertise approfondie en compétences, composants ou outils de base en génie de la puissance pour fournir des conseils techniques à vos pairs. Optimiser les processus de conception et les solutions client indépendamment ou en collaborant avec des équipes spécialisées interfonctionnelles.

  • Normalisation des produits: Contribuer à l'évolution de nos familles de produits de traction par la normalisation et des améliorations continues. Tirer parti de votre expertise pour stimuler l'innovation dans l'intégration des convertisseurs de traction à l'ESS.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Power Electronics Expertise : Un ingénieur électricien/électronique qualifié ayant une solide expérience en conception et en ingénierie de l'électronique de puissance. L'expérience des convertisseurs de traction et des systèmes de stockage d'énergie est un avantage.

  • Curiosité et apprentissage continu: Désireuse d'élargir continuellement l'expertise technique, de favoriser l'amélioration continue, de partager les connaissances avec l'équipe, de favoriser une culture de croissance et de collaboration.

  • Problem Solver & Team Player: Une personne proactive qui réussit à relever des défis complexes et à s'approprier ses tâches, tout en étant un acteur efficace au sein d'une équipe inclusive.

  • Communiqueur efficace : Une communication claire et efficace en anglais est essentielle, écrite et parlée. Les compétences linguistiques en allemand sont un avantage important.

  • Willingness to Travel: Possibilités occasionnelles de voyage pour appuyer des projets.

Rejoignez-nous et élevez votre carrière dans le monde palpitant des systèmes de conduite de véhicules ! C'est l'occasion pour vous de prospérer et de croître tout en ayant un impact significatif sur l'avenir du transport durable!

jobs.title: (80 - 100%) Senior Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Manager - Commercial&Operations

__

Working in the Energy Industries division, based in eastern Europe, optionally worldwide, you will be cooperating with international teams to maintain the highest levels of customer satisfaction in our worldwide applied solutions for electrical power generation. Reporting to the Head of Product Support, you will perform various product and life cycle activities to assist in the development, launch, maintenance, and profitability of UNITROL, MEGATROL and SYNCHROTACT products.


The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Own product lifecycle management and continuous improvement by leading feasibility studies and managing global product changes (HW/SW/BOM, tools, documentation, etc.). You contribute to cost optimization, standardization, and continuous product enhancement in close collaboration with Product Management and R&D
  • Drive product quality and technical excellence by analyzing and resolving complex issues across a broad product portfolio. You engage directly with customers and perform remote diagnostics, lead root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure sustainable corrective actions to enhance product reliability and performance
  • Act as a global technical authority by providing expert support to ABB teams and business partners worldwide. You support project-specific adaptations, review engineered solutions, and guide standardization decisions aligned with long-term product strategy
  • Strengthen knowledge sharing and team capabilities by capturing learnings from support cases and translating them into structured knowledge documentation. You coach support line specialists and contribute to building strong global lifecycle support expertise

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor or master’s in electrical engineering
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in field service or engineering with Power Generation System know how, Embedded Software and Control Hardware plus Power Electronics (Experience with excitation systems is required)
  • Fluency in English, any other languages like German, French, or Spanish are an asset
  • Intrinsic attitude to drive innovation and improvement
  • Proven organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • High sense of responsibility and commitment
  • High degree of intercultural awareness

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Technical Service Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__


Your role and responsibilities

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will oversee commissioning in projects with low to medium complexity, and guide Associate Commissioning Engineers and coordinating work. You will ensure that commissioning activities are completed efficiently and cost-effectively, in accordance with specifications, standards, and safety requirements.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Energy Industries division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Commissioning and servicing of Automatic Voltage Regulators and Static Excitation Systems in power plants of all types and sizes, including voltage regulators in power plant installations with capacities up to 1000 MW. Conduct remote services and support to enhance the solutions and additionally perform network stability studies with a focus on power plant stabilities and grid code compliance.

  • Assist in continuous improvement of project design, participate in project review meetings, and provide input on service activities. Help create proposals for engineering projects or programs and assist Contract Managers in issuing claims.

  • Create work plans and cost estimates for various tasks, conduct risk and opportunity assessments during commissioning, and report potential risks and resolutions. Identify and recommend solutions to meet business and customer needs and provide relevant information accordingly.

  • Provide information to contractors and colleagues and give feedback to the organization to apply lessons learned. Apply and improve processes and tools through automation and digitalization to ensure effective project delivery.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in either commissioning for the power generation industry or as power system engineer responsible for power system studies.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and written and spoken communication skills in English (German advance).

  • Excitement and interest for digitalization of remote service concepts.

  • In-depth knowledge of power systems simulation tools (PowerFactory and PSS\E), synchronous machines and excitation systems as well as profound understanding of control theory, data analysis and information technology.

  • Eagerness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide—travel commitment up to 60%.

More about us

ABB Energy Industries is enabling safe, smart and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify industry we connect our people and technology to help our customers adapt and succeed.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Leader Product Management

__

In this role, you will be part of the DC UPS agile team. As a Product Manager within the team you will be responsible for profitable growth of your product line driving and contributing return on investment for ABB’s Power Protection business. You will be part of the DC UPS strategy to market covering specific UPS product lines ensuring ABB has a full understanding of market requirements and transforming those requirements into offer specifications and development activities.

You will also showcase your expertise by performing various offer lifecycle activities a: supporting development, value propositions developments, driving successful launches, managing product maintenance, pricing, and profitability—while meeting aggressive cost-per-kW targets and sustainability commitments.

The role is a Global role with no intention for relocation, the designated locations are where Critical Power have manufacturing units and hence are of a preference, although all candidates are welcome to apply and will be considered.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid and the preferred location of hire is Europe or US


Your role and responsibilities
  • Understanding and following global standards, market and customer requirements, and their impact on the current offer portfolio.
  • Conducting valuation of market size and trends, competitor benchmarking (including reverse-costing), and identifying offering gaps to strengthen ABB’s market standing.
  • Collaborate within the team and other Electrification teams in regards of DC developments and align products with technical standards to ensure a succesful DC UPS development.
  • Managing technical specifications for assigned products and supporting business cases for new developments, cost reduction, and lifecycle transitions.
  • Driving design-to-cost initiatives to achieve low kW targets without compromising quality or compliance.
  • Coordinating IEC/UL certification pathways, sustainability deliverables (EPDs, circularity), and preconfigured solution codes for priority regions.
  • Drive go-to-market activities, including product launches and brand positioning together with other global functions including sales enablement, customer success, training, support, and product expertise where needed.
  • Drive pricing models and be adept at working with templates, thereby achieve target profitability.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Business Administration (or equivalent).
  • You are highly skilled in Agile methodologies and product management. Understanding of High power / DC technologies within product management are considered an advantage.
  • Ability to demonstrate 5+ years of experience in product management. Gate model experience, stakeholder management and collaboration capabilities together with global functions as Sales, Operations, Service for product success
  • Previous experience with an adjacent topic to DC technologies / products /solutions are nice-to-have
  • Possess advanced knowledge of PLM tools, SAP, and MS Office Suite; familiarity with cost modeling and competitor benchmarking is a plus.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage for APAC engagement.
  • Ability to travel internationally as required.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Kapitelleiter Produktmanagement

In dieser Funktion bist du Teil des agilen Teams von DC UPS. Als Produktmanager innerhalb des Teams bist du für das profitable Wachstum deiner Produktlinie verantwortlich und trägst den Return on Investment für ABB's Power Protection Business bei. Sie werden Teil der DC UPS-Strategie zur Vermarktung spezifischer UPS-Produktlinien sein, um sicherzustellen, dass ABB die Marktanforderungen vollständig versteht und diese Anforderungen in Angebotsspezifikationen und Entwicklungsaktivitäten umwandelt.

Sie werden Ihre Expertise auch durch die Durchführung verschiedener Angebotslebenszyklusaktivitäten unter Beweis stellen: Unterstützung der Entwicklung, Wertversprechensentwicklungen, erfolgreiche Einführungen, Verwaltung von Produktwartung, Preisgestaltung und Rentabilität- bei gleichzeitiger Erfüllung aggressiver Kosten pro kW-Ziele und Nachhaltigkeitsverpflichtungen.

Die Rolle ist eine globale Rolle ohne Absicht für eine Umsiedlung, die benannten Standorte sind, an denen Critical Power Produktionseinheiten haben und daher bevorzugt sind, obwohl alle Kandidaten sich bewerben können und in Betracht gezogen werden.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: Hybrid und der bevorzugte Standort ist Europa oder USA


Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten
  • Globale Standards, Markt- und Kundenanforderungen und ihre Auswirkungen auf das aktuelle Angebotsportfolio verstehen und befolgen.
  • Bewertung der Marktgröße und -trends, Benchmarking der Wettbewerber (einschließlich Reverse-Costing) und Ermittlung von Angebotslücken zur Stärkung der Marktposition von ABB.
  • Arbeiten Sie innerhalb des Teams und anderer Elektrifizierungsteams in Bezug auf DC-Entwicklungen zusammen und richten Sie Produkte an technischen Standards aus, um eine erfolgreiche DC-USV-Entwicklung sicherzustellen.
  • Verwaltung technischer Spezifikationen für zugewiesene Produkte und Unterstützung von Business Cases für neue Entwicklungen, Kostenreduzierung und Lebenszyklusübergänge.
  • Förderung von Design-to-Cost-Initiativen zur Erreichung niedriger kW-Ziele, ohne Kompromisse bei Qualität oder Compliance einzugehen.
  • Koordination von IEC/UL-Zertifizierungspfaden, Nachhaltigkeitsergebnissen (EPDs, Circularity) und vorkonfigurierten Lösungscodes für prioritäre Regionen.
  • Förderung von Go-to-Market-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Produkteinführungen und Markenpositionierung, zusammen mit anderen globalen Funktionen wie Sales Enablement, Kundenerfolg, Schulung, Support und Produktexpertise, wenn nötig.
  • Führen Sie Preismodelle und seien Sie geschickt in der Arbeit mit Vorlagen, damit Ziel Rentabilität zu erreichen.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering oder Business Administration (oder gleichwertig).
  • Sie sind hochqualifiziert in Agile Methoden und Produktmanagert. Verständnis von High Power / DC-Technologien im Produktmanagement werden als Vorteil angesehen.
  • Fähigkeit, 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagert. Gate Modellerfahrung, Stakeholder Management und Collaboration-Fähigkeiten zusammen mit globalen Funktionen wie Sales, Operations, Service für den Produkterfolg Frühere Erfahrungen mit einem angrenzenden Thema zu DC Technologien / Produkte /Lösungen sind nice-to-have
  • Verfügen über fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in PLM-Tools, SAP und MS Office Suite; Vertrautheit mit Kostenmodellierung und Wettbewerber-Benchmarking ist ein Plus.
  • Fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Vorteil für APAC-Engagement.
  • Fähigkeit, international zu reisen, wie erforderlich.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will operate process equipment and machinery to convert raw materials or semi‑finished goods into components or finished parts for end products — at the right time and in the required quality. You will carry out your assigned tasks daily in accordance with agreed workflows, ABB standard processes, and safety guidelines, and you will report any deviations. In addition, you will operate machines according to the operating manual, work plan, and/or production order.

Work model: #LI-Onsite

Location: Electrification, Installation Products, Uster

Your Main • Responsibilities

  • Performing routine machine setups, adjustments, repairs, and replacement of simple wear parts

  • Ensuring regular standard maintenance of equipment, tool setup, programming tasks, troubleshooting, and reporting malfunctions; maintaining detailed records of setups, repairs, and maintenance activities

  • Monitoring and documenting good parts, scrap parts, and finished products

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Completed vocational training as a plastics technologist or toolmaker

  • At least 5 years of practical experience in injection molding and extrusion, including machine setup, start-up, and troubleshooting

  • Skilled in setting up, adjusting, and optimizing injection molding machines, tools, hot runner systems, and process parameters

  • Experience in sampling new injection molding tools, conducting initial production runs, and preparing complete production and quality documentation

  • Solid understanding of quality standards, safety and environmental regulations, and practical application of 5S and structured process control

  • Solid organizational skills, technical problem-solving abilities, and team spirit in an injection molding environment

  • Good German skills (spoken and written) for effective communication, documentation, and coordination in the production area

  • ERP knowledge (SAP)

Your Benefits

• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Market-rate salary, plus bonus, 13th-month pay, and participation opportunities (ESAP)

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu steuern, was die Welt regiert.

Ihre Rolle und • Zuständigkeiten

In dieser Funktion betreiben Sie Prozessanlagen und Maschinen, um Rohstoffe oder Halbzeuge in Komponenten oder Fertigteile für Endprodukte umzuwandeln – zur richtigen Zeit und in der erforderlichen Qualität. Sie führen Ihre zugewiesenen Aufgaben täglich nach vereinbarten Workflows, ABB-Standardprozessen und Sicherheitsrichtlinien aus und melden Abweichungen. Darüber hinaus betreiben Sie Maschinen gemäß Bedienungsanleitung, Arbeitsplan und/oder Produktionsauftrag.

Arbeitsmodell: #LI-Onsite

Standort: Elektrifizierung, Installationsprodukte, Uster

Dein Main • Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Durchführen von routinemäßigen Maschineneinstellungen, Einstellungen, Reparaturen und Austausch von einfachen Verschleißteilen

  • Sicherstellung einer regelmäßigen Standardwartung von Ausrüstung, Werkzeugeinrichtung, Programmieraufgaben, Fehlerbehebung und Meldung von Fehlfunktionen; Aufrechterhaltung detaillierter Aufzeichnungen über Einstellungen, Reparaturen und Wartungstätigkeiten

  • Überwachung und Dokumentation von Gutteilen, Altteilen und Fertigprodukten

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Kunststofftechnologen oder Werkzeugmacher

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Spritzgießen und Extrudieren, einschließlich Maschinenaufbau, Inbetriebnahme und Fehlersuche

  • Geschick im Einrichten, Einstellen und Optimieren von Spritzgießmaschinen, Werkzeugen, Heißkanalsystemen und Prozessparametern

  • Erfahrung in der Beprobung neuer Spritzgießwerkzeuge, der Durchführung von ersten Produktionsläufen und der Erstellung einer vollständigen Produktions- und Qualitätsdokumentation

  • Solides Verständnis von Qualitätsstandards, Sicherheits- und Umweltvorschriften sowie praktische Anwendung von 5S und strukturierter Prozesssteuerung

  • Solide Organisationskompetenzen, technische Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und Teamgeist im Spritzgießumfeld

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse (gesprochen und geschrieben) für eine effektive Kommunikation, Dokumentation und Koordination im Produktionsbereich

  • ERP-Kenntnisse (SAP)

Ihr Nutzen

• Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern eine Reihe attraktiver Leistungen, darunter:

  • Marktpreisgehalt zuzüglich Bonus, 13. Monatslohn und Beteiligungsmöglichkeiten (ESAP)

  • Berufsentwicklung durch gezielte Weiterbildungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

  • Nachhaltigkeits- und Mobilitätsvorteile, einschließlich eines Ökobonus für Arbeitnehmer, die nicht mit dem Auto pendeln

  • Ermäßigungen wie REKA-Checks, Swibeco-Vorteile und Felfel-Lebensmittelautomaten

Über uns

ABB Installation Products Division (ehemals Thomas&Betts) helfen bei der Verwaltung des Anschlusses, des Schutzes und der Verteilung von elektrischer Energie von der Quelle bis zur Steckdose. Die Produkte der Division sind so konzipiert, dass sie eine einfache Installation und Leistung unter anspruchsvollen und rauen Bedingungen bieten und dazu beitragen, die Sicherheit und den kontinuierlichen Betrieb für Versorgungsunternehmen, Unternehmen und Menschen auf der ganzen Welt zu gewährleisten. Das Produktsegment Commercial Essentials umfasst elektrische Anschlussdosen, gewerbliche Armaturen, Streben- und Kabelschalen-Metallrahmensysteme für den Gewerbe- und Wohnbau. Das Produktsegment Premier Industrial umfasst mehrere Produktlinien, wie z. B. Ty-Rap®-Kabelbinder, T&B Liquidtight Systems®-Schutzprodukte, PVC-beschichtete und Nylon-Leitungssysteme, Stromanschluss- und Erdungssysteme sowie Kabelschutzsysteme von Leitungen und Armaturen für raue und industrielle Anwendungen. Die Division stellt auch Lösungen für Mittelspannungsanwendungen her, die auf dem Versorgungsmarkt unter ihren Marken verwendet werden, darunter ElastimoldTM-Rückschlüsse und -Schaltanlagen, Kondensatorschalter, Strombegrenzungssicherungen, HomacTM-Verteilerstecker, Hi-Tech ValiantTM-Vollstreckenstrombegrenzungssicherung für Brandschutz, fehlerhafte Stromanzeiger und Verteilerstecker, Kabelzubehör und Geräte mit Produkten für die Über- und Untertageverteilung. Die Fertigung umfasst maßgeschneiderte und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Talent Partner geleitet Mara Werne.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

  • Surveiller et documenter les bonnes pièces, les pièces détachées et les produits finis

  • Au moins 5 années d'expérience pratique dans le moulage et l'extrusion par injection, y compris la configuration de la machine, le démarrage et le dépannage

  • Compétence pour la mise en place, le réglage et l'optimisation des machines de moulage par injection, des outils, des systèmes de coureur chaud et des paramètres de processus

  • Expérience de l'échantillonnage des nouveaux outils de moulage par injection, de la réalisation des premiers cycles de production et de la préparation de la documentation complète sur la production et la qualité

  • Bonnes compétences en allemand (parlé et écrit) pour une communication, une documentation et une coordination efficaces dans le domaine de la production

La Division des produits d'installation d'ABB (anciennement Thomas&Betts) aide à gérer la connexion, la protection et la distribution de l'électricité de la source à la prise. Les produits de la Division sont conçus pour faciliter l'installation et se dérouler dans des conditions difficiles et exigeantes, ce qui contribue à assurer la sécurité et le fonctionnement continu des services publics, des entreprises et des gens du monde entier. Le segment de produit Commercial Essentials comprend des boîtes de jonction électriques, des raccords commerciaux, des systèmes d'encadrement en métal à étrier et à plateau de câbles pour la construction commerciale et résidentielle. Le segment de produits Premier Industrial comprend plusieurs gammes de produits, tels que les attaches de câbles Ty-Rap®, les produits de protection T&B Liquidtight Systems®, les systèmes de gaines en PVC et en nylon, les systèmes de connexion électrique et de mise à la terre, et les systèmes de protection des câbles de gaines et d'accessoires pour les applications industrielles et dures. La Division fabrique également des solutions pour les applications à moyenne tension utilisées sur le marché des services publics dans le cadre de ses marques de marque ElastimoldTM et de commutateurs, des commutateurs de condensateur, des fusibles limiteurs de courant, des connecteurs de distribution HomacTM, des fusibles limiteurs de courant Hi-Tech valiantTM pour l'atténuation du feu, des indicateurs de courant défectueux et des connecteurs de distribution, des accessoires de câbles et des appareils avec des produits pour la distribution aérienne et souterraine. Global Head of Mobile e-Power

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this position you will be responsible for driving the strategy, development, commercialization, and lifecycle management of ABB's Mobile e-Power Systems portfolio.

You will manage ABB’s global Mobile e-Power Systems portfolio, including power converters, electric traction motors, battery energy storage, power distribution, and control systems for applications across mining, construction, off-highway equipment, public transportation, marine, and other industrial mobility segments. Working closely with customers, OEMs, sales, engineering, R&D, and operations teams, you will drive portfolio strategy, support key electrification projects, and translate market needs into innovative solutions that accelerate business growth and strengthen ABB’s leadership in sustainable mobility.

Work model: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading the market intelligence analysis and identifying potential gaps in the portfolio, with respect to the competition and new market opportunities.

  • Owning technical and market specification for the offer and determining an offering business plan that supports sustainable growth while leading customer need and value analysis, planning the roadmap to create maximum value, and following-up on portfolio performance.

  • Leading the offer lifecycle management process, analyzing current offers, defining, and tracking performance metrics, and making decisions on offer obsolescence and end-of life to ensure that current and future market requirements are met to maximize their profitability.

  • Setting targets, monitoring offering costs and giving inputs to operations functions (e.g., Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Production) to maximize competitiveness and profitability.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, systems engineering, business development, application engineering, or related roles.

  • Experience with electrified powertrain systems, power electronics, electric drives, battery systems, charging systems, energy storage systems, or related electrification technologies.

  • Solid understanding of product lifecycle management, portfolio strategy, and business planning.

  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global, and multicultural environments.

  • Strong analytical, strategic, commercial, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English.

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (approximately 10–20%) to support business growth and portfolio objectives.


More about us

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. You will manage ABB’s global Mobile e-Power Systems portfolio, including power converters, electric traction motors, battery energy storage, power distribution, and control systems for applications across mining, construction, off-highway equipment, public transportation, marine, and other industrial mobility segments. Working closely with customers, OEMs, sales, engineering, R&D, and operations teams, you will drive portfolio strategy, support key electrification projects, and translate market needs into innovative solutions that accelerate business growth and strengthen ABB’s leadership in sustainable mobility.

  • Leading the market intelligence analysis and identifying potential gaps in the portfolio, with respect to the competition and new market opportunities.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, systems engineering, business development, application engineering, or related roles.

  • Experience with electrified powertrain systems, power electronics, electric drives, battery systems, charging systems, energy storage systems, or related electrification technologies.

  • Solid understanding of product lifecycle management, portfolio strategy, and business planning.

  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global, and multicultural environments.

  • Strong analytical, strategic, commercial, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English.

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (approximately 10–20%) to support business growth and portfolio objectives.

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

Your Role

In this dynamic sales position, you will drive market development with switchgear manufacturers across the North-West region of German-speaking Switzerland. You will identify market opportunities, build strong customer relationships, and successfully position our electrical power distribution solutions. Working collaboratively with internal teams, channel partners, and stakeholders, you'll contribute directly to sustainable business growth.

Work Model: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden, Kanton Aargau.

  • Coordinate all stakeholders and manage professional sales processes, ensuring accurate communication on delivery times, terms, and contractual conditions

• Qualifications

  • Structured, solution-oriented approach with strong prioritization and adaptability in dynamic environments

  • Collaborative team player with professional communication skills and cross-departmental mindset

  • Language skills: Native German speaker, any additional language is a plus

  • Valid Category B driving license and a valid Swiss work permit

Benefits

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings optimizes energy efficiency, safety, security, and comfort across all building types through innovative digital technologies and integrated solutions. We serve diverse markets—from single-family homes to industrial applications—with scalable solutions that deliver sustainable and financial benefits while supporting carbon reduction strategies.

This recruiting process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving front end sales for large and strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a full-scope solution provider across the mining value chain. You will lead sales activities for complex international opportunities, covering the broader ABB portfolio in electrification, automation, drives and digital solutions, with an additional focus on the grinding portfolio.

The work model for the role is: Onsite

This role is contributing to AUPI in Switzerland. Main stakeholders are Global Accounts, EPCMs and key Local Business Lines within AUPI.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Driving the sales of strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a global solution provider.

  • Promoting and selling the full ABB portfolio for mining, including high voltage, medium voltage, low voltage, variable frequency drives, electrification, automation and digital solutions, with an additional focus on the grinding portfolio, including GMDs, RMDs and related applications.

  • Leading front-end sales activities for large, international mining opportunities with multiple stakeholders.

  • Managing capture teams and coordinating multinational and cross-functional resources towards a winning strategy.

  • Developing and executing account and opportunity strategies in close collaboration with account managers, OEMs, EPCMs and local ABB units.

  • Ensuring ABB’s value proposition is clearly communicated and professionally presented to customers and stakeholders.

  • Leading strategic discussions related to scope allocation and division of responsibilities between global and local units.

  • Building, qualifying and developing a strong pipeline of mining opportunities to support sustainable growth.

Our team dynamics

You will join a talented, high-performing and internationally connected team, where collaboration, business insight and customer focus are key to success.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the mining industry or similar, with a strong track record in sales or execution of complex industrial solutions.

  • Proven experience in front end sales, strategic project sales or solution sales in mining or similar heavy industrial environments.

  • Strong knowledge of electrification, automation, drives and/or digital solutions for mining, with a solution-oriented approach.

  • Experience in the grinding domain, including GMDs, RMDs or similar applications, is a strong advantage.

  • Experience in process, drives and control applications related to mining is an advantage.

  • Established strategic contacts with OEMs and/or EPCMs in the mining industry are highly desirable.

  • Preferably a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Demonstrated success in leading multinational and multicultural teams in complex project environments, with strong communication, influencing and stakeholder alignment skills.

What’s in it for you?

  • Opportunity to shape ABB’s position in some of the world’s largest mining projects.

  • Exposure to global customers, EPCMs and ABB stakeholders across multiple countries.

  • A highly visible role with strategic impact on business growth.

  • The chance to work in an international environment with experienced sales and execution professionals.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Condurrà attività di vendita per complesse opportunità internazionali, coprendo il più ampio portafoglio ABB in elettrificazione, automazione, azionamento e soluzioni digitali, con un ulteriore focus sul portafoglio di rettifica.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: Onsite

Questo ruolo contribuisce all'AUPI in Svizzera. I principali stakeholder sono Global Account, EPCM e le principali linee di business locali all'interno dell'AUPI.

Sarete responsabili principalmente di: - Guidare le vendite di progetti minerari strategici, posizionando ABB come fornitore globale di soluzioni. - Promuovere e vendere l'intero portafoglio ABB per l'estrazione mineraria, compresi l'alta tensione, la media tensione, la bassa tensione, unità a frequenza variabile, l'elettrificazione, l'automazione e le soluzioni digitali, con un ulteriore focus sul portafoglio di rettifica, compresi GMD, RMD e applicazioni correlate. - Leading attività di vendita front-end per grandi opportunità minerarie internazionali con più stakeholder.

- Gestione dei team di acquisizione e coordinamento delle risorse multinazionali e interfunzionali verso una strategia vincente. - Sviluppo ed esecuzione di strategie di account e opportunità in stretta collaborazione con account manager, OEM, EPCM e unità ABB locali. - Garantire che la proposta di valore di ABB.s sia chiaramente comunicata e presentata professionalmente a clienti e stakeholder. - Leading discussioni strategiche relative all'allocazione dello scopo e alla divisione delle responsabilità tra unità globali e locali.

- Costruzione, qualificazione e sviluppo di una forte pipeline di opportunità minerarie per sostenere la crescita sostenibile.

Le nostre dinamiche del team Unirai a un team di talento, performante e connesso a livello internazionale, dove la collaborazione, la conoscenza delle imprese e l'attenzione dei clienti sono fondamentali per il successo.

Qualificazioni per il ruolo - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel settore minerario o simili, con un forte record di vendite o l'esecuzione di soluzioni industriali complesse. - Proven esperienza nelle vendite di fronte alla fine, vendita di progetti strategici o vendita di soluzioni in miniere o ambienti industriali pesanti simili. - Forte conoscenza di elettrificazione, automazione, azionamenti e/o soluzioni digitali per l'estrazione mineraria, con un approccio orientato alla soluzione. - L'esperienza nel settore della rettifica, compresi GMD, RMD o applicazioni simili, è un forte vantaggio.

- Sono altamente desiderabili contatti strategici con OEM e/o EPCM nel settore minerario. - Preferibilmente una laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Automatica o una disciplina tecnica correlata. - Successo dimostrato in team multinazionali e multiculturali leader in ambienti di progetto complessi, con forte comunicazione, influenza e capacità di allineamento delle parti interessate.

Cosa c'è in esso per voi? - Possibilità di dare forma alla posizione di ABB.s in alcuni dei più grandi progetti minerari del mondo. - Esposizione a clienti globali, EPCM e stakeholder ABB in diversi paesi. - Un ruolo altamente visibile con impatto strategico sulla crescita del business. - La possibilità di lavorare in un ambiente internazionale con professionisti esperti delle vendite e delle esecuzioni.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Contatto Pronto per fare un impatto?

Was, ist es für Sie? - Gelegenheit, ABB, eine Position in einigen der weltweit größten Bergbauprojekte zu gestalten. - Exposition gegenüber globalen Kunden, EPCMs und ABB Stakeholder in mehreren Ländern. - Eine sehr sichtbare Rolle mit strategischen Auswirkungen auf das Wachstum des Unternehmens. - Die Chance, in einem internationalen Umfeld mit erfahrenen Vertriebs-und Ausführungsexperten arbeiten.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Global Strategic Projects, Mining
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving front end sales for large and strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a full-scope solution provider across the mining value chain. You will lead sales activities for complex international opportunities, covering the broader ABB portfolio in electrification, automation and digital solutions.

The work model for the role is: Onsite

This role is contributing to AUPI in Switzerland. Main stakeholders are Global Accounts, EPCMs and key Local Business Lines within AUPI.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Driving the sales of strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a global solution provider.

  • Promoting and selling the full ABB portfolio for mining, including high voltage, medium voltage, low voltage, variable frequency drives, electrification, automation and digital solutions.

  • Leading front end sales activities for large, international mining opportunities with multiple stakeholders.

  • Managing capture teams and coordinating multinational and cross-functional resources towards a winning strategy.

  • Developing and executing account and opportunity strategies in close collaboration with account managers, EPCMs and local ABB units.

  • Ensuring ABB’s value proposition is clearly communicated and professionally presented to customers and stakeholders.

  • Leading strategic discussions related to scope allocation and division of responsibilities between global and local units.

  • Building, qualifying and developing a strong pipeline of mining opportunities to support sustainable growth.

Our team dynamics

You will join a talented, high-performing and internationally connected team, where collaboration, business insight and customer focus are key to success.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the mining industry or similar, with a strong track record in sales or execution of complex industrial solutions.

  • Proven experience in front end sales, strategic project sales or solution sales in mining or similar heavy industrial environments.

  • Preferably a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Demonstrated success in leading multinational and multicultural teams in complex project environments.

  • Strong functional leadership skills, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders around a common strategy and execution plan.

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, including the ability to lead strategic discussions across business units with different priorities and objectives.

  • Fluent in English. Spanish and/or German would be an advantage.

  • Valid work permit for Switzerland or Europe.

What’s in it for you?

  • Opportunity to shape ABB’s position in some of the world’s largest mining projects.

  • Exposure to global customers, EPCMs and ABB stakeholders across multiple countries.

  • A highly visible role with strategic impact on business growth.

  • The chance to work in an international environment with experienced sales and execution professionals.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Sales Manager - Panel Builders (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

__

As Sales Manager - Panel Builders, you will lead one of ABB Electrification's key sales channels in Switzerland. Combining strategic leadership with a strong customer focus, you will drive profitable growth, strengthen long-term customer relationships, and lead a high-performing sales team. Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will play an important role in shaping our commercial success while helping customers accelerate the transition to a more sustainable and electrified future.

The working model is: LI-Hybrid

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the local Panel Builders sales team, fostering a high-performance, customer-centric culture and ensuring strong market coverage across all regions of Switzerland.

  • Drive profitable growth by identifying new business opportunities and implementing effective sales, market segmentation, and pricing strategies aligned with ABB’s business objectives.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and partners, ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product marketing, operations, and other stakeholders to support business success, while coordinating sales information flow, providing accurate forecasts and market insights, and managing commercial and contractual risks.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree or similar in a technical field (preferably Electrical Engineering) with minimum 3 years of successful sales leadership background with a proven track record in the Swiss market.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience and solid cross-functional collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.

  • Good technical knowledge of energy distribution and low-voltage switchgear or similar technical field. Furthermore, ability and interest to sell and promote digital solutions.

  • Sound understanding of contract negotiations, risk management, and commercial and legal terms.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a professional, proactive "can-do" attitude.

  • Fluent in German, with a good command of French and English.

More about us:

Electrification offers technologies across the entire electrification value chain—from the substation to the point of consumption. In doing so, it contributes to a secure and reliable power supply. The portfolio includes digital and connected innovations that improve the reliability and efficiency of low- and medium-voltage electrical installations. These include electric vehicle charging infrastructure, modular substations, distribution automation solutions, switchgear, sensor technology and control systems, as well as KNX systems for the automation and networking of building infrastructure.

This recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

__

As Sales Manager - Panel Builders, you will lead one of ABB Electrification's key sales channels in Switzerland. Combining strategic leadership with a strong customer focus, you will drive profitable growth, strengthen long-term customer relationships, and lead a high-performing sales team. Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will play an important role in shaping our commercial success while helping customers accelerate the transition to a more sustainable and electrified future.

The working model is: LI-Hybrid

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the local Panel Builders sales team, fostering a high-performance, customer-centric culture and ensuring strong market coverage across all regions of Switzerland.

  • Drive profitable growth by identifying new business opportunities and implementing effective sales, market segmentation, and pricing strategies aligned with ABB’s business objectives.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and partners, ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product marketing, operations, and other stakeholders to support business success, while coordinating sales information flow, providing accurate forecasts and market insights, and managing commercial and contractual risks.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree or similar in a technical field (preferably Electrical Engineering) with minimum 3 years of successful sales leadership background with a proven track record in the Swiss market.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience and solid cross-functional collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.

  • Good technical knowledge of energy distribution and low-voltage switchgear or similar technical field. Furthermore, ability and interest to sell and promote digital solutions.

  • Sound understanding of contract negotiations, risk management, and commercial and legal terms.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a professional, proactive "can-do" attitude.

  • Fluent in German, with a good command of French and English.

More about us:

Electrification offers technologies across the entire electrification value chain—from the substation to the point of consumption. In doing so, it contributes to a secure and reliable power supply. The portfolio includes digital and connected innovations that improve the reliability and efficiency of low- and medium-voltage electrical installations. These include electric vehicle charging infrastructure, modular substations, distribution automation solutions, switchgear, sensor technology and control systems, as well as KNX systems for the automation and networking of building infrastructure.

This recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

Als Sales Manager - Panel Builders leiten Sie einen der wichtigsten Vertriebskanäle von ABB Electrification in der Schweiz. Durch die Kombination von strategischer Führung mit einer starken Kundenorientierung werden Sie profitables Wachstum vorantreiben, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen stärken und ein leistungsstarkes Verkaufsteam leiten. • Ihre Hauptaufgaben werden sein:

  • Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie das lokale Panel Builders-Vertriebsteam, fördern Sie eine leistungsstarke, kundenorientierte Kultur und sorgen Sie für eine starke Marktabdeckung in allen Regionen der Schweiz.

  • Steigern Sie profitables Wachstum, indem Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren und effektive Vertriebs-, Marktsegmentierungs- und Preisstrategien implementieren, die auf die Geschäftsziele von ABB ausgerichtet sind.

  • Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden und Partnern, um eine hervorragende Kundenerfahrung während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses zu gewährleisten.

Was wir suchen:

  • Bachelor-Abschluss oder ähnliches in einem technischen Bereich (vorzugsweise Elektrotechnik) mit mindestens 3 Jahren erfolgreicher Vertriebsführung mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz auf dem Schweizer Markt.

  • Demonstrierte Führungserfahrung und solide funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und Teamfähigkeit mit der Fähigkeit, effektive Beziehungen über Funktionen und organisatorische Ebenen hinweg aufzubauen.

  • Gute technische Kenntnisse der Energieverteilung und Niederspannungsschaltanlagen oder ähnliches technisches Gebiet. Darüber hinaus die Fähigkeit und das Interesse, digitale Lösungen zu verkaufen und zu bewerben.

  • Ein fundiertes Verständnis von Vertragsverhandlungen, Risikomanagement sowie kaufmännischen und rechtlichen Bedingungen.

  • Außergewöhnliches Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsgeschick, eine kundenorientierte Denkweise und eine professionelle, proaktive "Can-Do" -Haltung.

  • Fluent auf Deutsch, mit guten Französisch- und Englischkenntnissen.

Mehr über uns:

Mehr über uns:

>Electrification bietet Technologien entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette der Elektrifizierung – vom Umspannwerk bis zum Verbrauchsort. Damit trägt sie zu einer sicheren und zuverlässigen Stromversorgung bei. Das Portfolio umfasst digitale und vernetzte Innovationen, die die Zuverlässigkeit und Effizienz von Nieder- und Mittelspannungsinstallationen verbessern. Dazu gehören Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge, modulare Umspannstationen, Verteilungsautomationslösungen, Schaltanlagen, Sensorik und Steuerungssysteme sowie KNX-Systeme für die Automatisierung und Vernetzung von Gebäudeinfrastruktur.

Dieser Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Reto Korstick, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Schweiz, geleitet.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

En tant que Sales Manager - Panel Builders, vous dirigerez l'un des principaux canaux de vente d'ABB Electrification en Suisse. Combinant leadership stratégique avec une forte concentration client, vous stimulerez la croissance rentable, renforcerez les relations client à long terme, et dirigerez une équipe de ventes hautement performante. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de l'ensemble de l'entreprise, vous jouerez un rôle important pour façonner notre succès commercial tout en aidant les clients à accélérer la transition vers un avenir plus durable et électrifié.

Le modèle de travail est : LI-Hybrid

Vos principales responsabilités seront :

  • Diriger, coacher et développer l'équipe locale de ventes de Panel Builders, en favorisant une culture de haute performance centrée sur le client et en assurant une forte couverture du marché dans toutes les régions de la Suisse.

  • Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les principaux clients et partenaires, en assurant une excellente expérience client tout au long du processus de vente.

  • Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle avec la commercialisation, la commercialisation des produits, les opérations et d'autres intervenants afin d'appuyer la réussite des entreprises, tout en coordonnant la circulation de l'information sur les ventes, en fournissant des prévisions précises et des perspectives de marché, et en gérant les risques commerciaux et contractuels.

Ce que nous recherchons :

  • Expérience de leadership des personnes démontrées et solide collaboration interfonctionnelle et compétences en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité d'établir des relations efficaces entre les fonctions et l'organisation.

  • Bonne connaissance technique de la distribution d'énergie et de la commande à basse tension ou d'un domaine technique similaire. En outre, la capacité et l'intérêt de vendre et de promouvoir des solutions numériques.

  • Bonne compréhension des négociations contractuelles, de la gestion des risques et des termes commerciaux et juridiques.

  • Des compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en négociation, un état d'esprit axé sur le client et une attitude professionnelle et proactive.

  • Fluent en allemand, avec une bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais.

Plus sur nous:

L'électrification offre des technologies dans toute la chaîne de valeur de l'électrification, depuis la sous-station jusqu'au point de consommation. Ce faisant, elle contribue à une alimentation électrique sûre et fiable. Le portefeuille comprend des innovations numériques et connectées qui améliorent la fiabilité et l'efficacité des installations électriques à basse et moyenne tension. Il s'agit notamment de l'infrastructure de recharge des véhicules électriques, des sous-stations modulaires, des solutions d'automatisation de la distribution, des systèmes de commutation, de la technologie des capteurs et des systèmes de commande, ainsi que des systèmes KNX pour l'automatisation et la mise en réseau des infrastructures de construction.

Ce processus de recrutement est dirigé par Reto Korstick, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Suisse.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

ABB Motors and Drives offre un portafoglio completo di motori, generatori e prodotti per la guida in un'ampia gamma di settori e applicazioni. jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world.
